speaker: Unknown
en: I went from 13,000 employees to three employees in one week.
zh: 我在一周内从 13,000 名员工变成了 3 名员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: WeWork was one of the fastest physical global growth the world's ever seen, but everything went wrong.
zh: WeWork 是全世界见过的最快的实体全球化增长之一,但一切都出了问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: We lost everything.
zh: 我们失去了一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: In 2019, we were publicly filed at S1.
zh: 2019 年,我们公开发布了 S1 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Company valued at around $47 billion.
zh: 公司估值约 470 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: The S1 showed some losses, three billion in the past three years.
zh: S1 显示了一些亏损,过去三年亏损 30 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, the S1 revealed when you were CEO that you'd also trademarked the word we and sold it back to the company.
zh: 另外,S1 还透露,当你担任 CEO 时,你还把"we"这个词注册了商标,然后又把它卖回给了公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not true.
zh: 那不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: People sometimes think I was fired because the Wall Street Journal said so.
zh: 人们有时以为我被解雇了,因为《华尔街日报》是这么说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not true.
zh: 不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to hear directly from you.
zh: 我想直接听你本人说。

speaker: Unknown
en: What happened?
zh: 发生了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: You really want to go there?
zh: 你真想去那里吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm happy to.
zh: 我很乐意。

speaker: Unknown
en: The floor is yours.
zh: 舞台交给你了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in WeWork, the business grew faster than I could grow.
zh: 在 WeWork,业务增长得比我能成长的速度还快。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every step I take, suddenly the ego starts coming up.
zh: 而我走的每一步,自我突然开始冒出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, 20 billion valuation, billion valuation in Japan.
zh: 哦,200 亿估值,日本 10 亿估值。

speaker: Unknown
en: On top of that, 5 billion valuation in China.
zh: 在此之上,中国还有 50 亿估值。

speaker: Unknown
en: It suddenly became about the money.
zh: 突然之间一切都变成了钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: I forgot what we were all about.
zh: 我忘记了我们究竟是为了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when I lost it, everybody lost it.
zh: 而当我失去了它,所有人也失去了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the next thing is we found ourselves being forced to go public when we weren't ready.
zh: 接下来就是我们发现自己在还没准备好的时候被迫上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then you resigned as CEO of WeWork after the IPO didn't pan out.
zh: 后来你在 IPO 没成之后辞去了 WeWork CEO 的职务。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I stepped down out of choice.
zh: 所以我是自己选择退下的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a second after I did it, we got stabbed in the back.
zh: 而在我退下的下一秒,我们就被背后捅了一刀。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the only lesson there, if you're going to stab the king, kill.
zh: 那里唯一的教训是,如果你要捅国王,就杀了他。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're not going to kill, I'm going to come back again.
zh: 如果你打算不杀,我会再次回来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why did you make that choice to go back into business again?
zh: 你为什么做出重新创业的选择?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because you had money from the reports, almost a billion dollars.
zh: 因为据报道,你有近 10 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know how hard it is.
zh: 你知道那有多难。

speaker: Unknown
en: I now realize that in WeWork, I did a lot more things right than wrong.
zh: 我现在意识到,在 WeWork,我做对的事情远多于做错的。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot more, not like 10% more, like 95%.
zh: 多得多,不是多 10%,是多 95%。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some of what I'm saying is hard for you to fully hone in on.
zh: 我说的有些话让你很难完全聚焦理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: But all these founders you spoke to, all this, I don't think they shared this label.
zh: 但你访谈过的所有这些创始人,所有这些,我不认为他们共享这个标签。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's talk about it.
zh: 那我们来聊聊吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: So first...
zh: 那么,首先……

speaker: Unknown
en: Guys, I've got a favor to ask before this episode begins.
zh: 各位,在本期节目开始之前,我想请大家帮个忙。

speaker: Unknown
en: The algorithm, if you follow a show, will deliver you the best episodes from that show very prominently in your feed.
zh: 算法,如果你关注一个节目,就会非常显眼地在你的信息流里推送那个节目最好的剧集。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when we have our best episodes on this show, the most shared episodes, the most rated episodes, I would love you to know.
zh: 所以当我们这个节目有最好的剧集时,被分享最多的、评分最高的剧集,我很希望你能知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the simple way for you to know that is to hit that follow button.
zh: 而让你知道的最简单方式,就是点那个关注按钮。

speaker: Unknown
en: But also, it's the simple, easy, free thing that you can do to help us make this show better.
zh: 而且,这也是你能做的帮我们把节目做得更好的简单、容易、免费的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I would be hugely grateful if you could take a minute on the app you're listening to this one right now and hit that follow button.
zh: 如果你能在你现在正在听这一期的应用上花一分钟,点一下那个关注按钮,我会非常感激。

speaker: Unknown
en: you
zh: 你

speaker: Unknown
en: Adam Newman, I've had the privilege of getting to know you briefly over the last couple of months.
zh: Adam Newman,过去几个月里我有幸简短地认识了你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it struck me almost immediately that you are unlike almost any other founder or CEO or really person I think I've ever met.
zh: 几乎立刻就让我震惊的是,你几乎不像我见过的任何其他创始人、CEO,或者真的,任何我曾见过的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a depth to you and a philosophy and a perspective that is just incredibly rare.
zh: 你身上有一种深度、一种哲学和一种视角,极其罕见。

speaker: Unknown
en: My question to you is for you to be an anomaly, if we accept that.
zh: 我的问题是,如果 我们接受这一点,你要成为一个异类。

speaker: Unknown
en: Am I right in thinking that you had some sort of anomalous early origin story?
zh: 我这样想对吗——你有一些不寻常的早期起源故事?

speaker: Unknown
en: What is that, that story that shaped this man that sat in front of me?
zh: 那是什么,那个塑造了坐在我面前这个人的故事?

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, for me first, when I get to know someone in the beginning and they say, where is it coming from?
zh: 你知道的,对我来说,当我一开始认识某人,他们问,你是从哪来的?

speaker: Unknown
en: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁?

speaker: Unknown
en: I usually start the same.
zh: 我通常都以同样的方式开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: First of all, I'm a husband.
zh: 首先,我是一名丈夫。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's my first job, what I'm most proud of.
zh: 这是我的第一份工作,是我最引以为豪的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I'm a father.
zh: 然后我是一名父亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a father of six.
zh: 我是六个孩子的父亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I'm a friend.
zh: 然后我是一名朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: Friendships are very important for me.
zh: 友谊对我来说非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And after that, I'm an entrepreneur.
zh: 在那之后,我才是一名创业者。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think each one of us has a
zh: 我认为我们每个人都有一颗

speaker: Unknown
en: phenomenal soul.
zh: 非凡的灵魂。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's perfect.
zh: 我认为它是完美的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think what really we see when we look at people is the distance between where we think they're holding to where their potential is.
zh: 我认为我们看人时真正看到的,是我们认为他们所处的位置与他们的潜力所在之间的距离。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think it's that gap between those two things that actually defines a person.
zh: 而我认为正是这两者之间的差距,才真正定义了一个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for me...
zh: 而对我而言……

speaker: Unknown
en: Throughout my life, sometimes out of my control when I was young, and sometimes with my control when I got older, I've always been striving to close that gap.
zh: 在我的一生中,有时是我小时候无法控制的,有时是我长大后在掌控之下的,我一直都在努力缩小那个差距。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you talk about not having control.
zh: 那么你提到过缺乏控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your early context is quite unstable from what I read because your mother suffered from bipolar.
zh: 据我所读到的,你早期的环境相当不稳定,因为你的母亲患有双相情感障碍。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you bring me into that world so I can understand the sort of context that Adam was raised?
zh: 你能带我走进那个世界,让我了解一下 Adam 成长的背景吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Happily.
zh: 很乐意。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we'll start, like every story, it has two sides to it.
zh: 那么就像每个故事一样,它有两面。

speaker: Unknown
en: My mom and my father are both doctors.
zh: 我妈妈和我父亲都是医生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And growing up, I always saw both of them taking care of the patients.
zh: 在成长过程中,我一直看到他们两人照顾着病人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it would feel sometimes like the patients came ahead of us.
zh: 有时会感觉病人排在我们前面。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, my sister and I, we were never sick.
zh: 比如说,我和姐姐,我们从来不生病。

speaker: Unknown
en: No matter how sick we were, we'd look at the man when she was an oncologist.
zh: 无论我们病得多厉害,我们都会去看母亲——她是肿瘤科医生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she would say, my patients are sicker, go to school.
zh: 而她会说,我的病人病得更重,去上学吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that was sort of the beginning of it.
zh: 那大概就是这一切的开端。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I was in the second grade, my parents got a divorce.
zh: 我上二年级的时候,我父母离婚了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was very difficult for my mom, and she needed a change of scenery, so we actually moved to the United States.
zh: 对我妈妈来说非常艰难,她需要一个环境的改变,所以我们真的搬到了美国。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know this photo here?
zh: 你认识这张照片吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I do.
zh: 认识。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this one here, you've got a kid.
zh: 这边这张,你有一个小孩。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is you as a child that is beaming with a smile, sort of ear to ear.
zh: 这是你小时候,笑容灿烂,咧到耳根的那种笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Often when I see photos like that, my curiosity is what...
zh: 每当我看到那样的照片时,我的好奇心是……

speaker: Unknown
en: what you can't see and what that young kid, that young boy there is not saying, but what he's feeling underneath all of those emotions.
zh: 你看不到的东西,那个小孩、那个小男孩没有说出来的话,以及他在所有那些情绪之下所感受的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I could tell you is I think for me, I think the challenge started in that.
zh: 我能告诉你的是,我想对我来说,挑战就是从那时开始的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we talked about my mother being bipolar.
zh: 所以我们谈过我母亲患有双相情感障碍。

speaker: Unknown
en: I only observed my mother's moods when we moved to the United States.
zh: 直到我们搬到美国后,我才观察到我母亲的情绪波动。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was no room around.
zh: 周围没有别人。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was only my mom and my sister and I.
zh: 只有我妈妈、我和姐姐。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all day she would work with the patients and at night at 8 p.m. she would come home and all hell would break loose.
zh: 她整天和病人打交道,晚上八点才回家,然后一切都天翻地覆。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember, there are many stories, but I remember this.
zh: 我记得,故事有很多,但我记得这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: She would tell my sister and I, we had to wash the dishes.
zh: 她会告诉我和姐姐,我们必须洗碗。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was our one chore.
zh: 那是我们唯一的一项家务。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we wouldn't, no matter what, because kids sometimes rebel by action when they can't rebel by words.
zh: 而我们偏偏不洗,无论如何都不洗,因为孩子有时候无法用言语反抗时,就会用行动来反抗。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she would come home, you didn't wash the dishes, and she would take the dishes and throw them on the floor.
zh: 她回到家,发现你没洗碗,就会拿起碗碟摔到地上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then she would cry and start cleaning the dishes and mopping them.
zh: 然后她会哭起来,开始收拾碗碟,把它们拖洗起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was every night ended with some version of action like that.
zh: 而且每天晚上都以某种类似这样的行为收场。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for two years, I remember how crazy my sister and I thought the whole experience was.
zh: 有两年时间,我记得我和我姐姐觉得整个经历有多疯狂。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we didn't have any friends who were sharing that experience.
zh: 而且我们没有任何朋友在分享那样的经历。

speaker: Unknown
en: Until one day she bought this nice set of dishes.
zh: 直到有一天她买了这套漂亮的餐具。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she comes home again to throw the dishes.
zh: 然后她又回家摔餐具。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we know that she's only throwing the cheap dishes.
zh: 而且我们知道她只摔那些便宜的餐具。

speaker: Unknown
en: She's not throwing the ones that she liked.
zh: 她不摔她喜欢的那几套。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which gave us a little hint that maybe there's a little more control over what's happening than this out of control situation.
zh: 这给了我们一点提示,也许对发生的事情还是有一些控制,并不是完全失控的处境。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if I had to guess what was happening with these kids, because now in hindsight I know my mom and my dad very well, probably there was a lot of arguing in the house.
zh: 所以如果让我猜这些孩子身上发生了什么——因为我现在 hindsight 里非常了解我妈妈和我爸爸——很可能家里有非常多的争吵。

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably as a kid, because I now see my kids that are very young, I'm sure a child finds it very confusing when the parents are not aligned as a team.
zh: 很可能在小时候——因为我现在看到我自己还很小的孩子们——我确信当父母没有作为一个团队保持一致时,孩子会觉得非常困惑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because as a child, all you have to lean on are your parents.
zh: 因为作为一个孩子,你能依靠的只有你的父母。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think the most important thing to say is
zh: 但我认为最重要要说的是

speaker: Unknown
en: If my mom wasn't the way she was, and if I didn't go through all those challenges that I went through growing up, and I went through a lot, we're talking about bipolar, there's a lot that comes with it.
zh: 如果我妈妈不是她那个样子,如果我在成长过程中没有经历那些挑战——而我经历了很多,我们说的是双相情感障碍,它伴随着很多东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we could go deeper or less, but almost every single thing, if you took a piece of paper and you had to do a check mark for every bad thing we think can happen to a little boy,
zh: 我们可以讲得更深或更浅,但几乎每一件事,如果你拿一张纸,每遇到一件我们认为可能发生在一个小男孩身上的坏事就打一个勾,

speaker: Unknown
en: You get to checkmark with me almost all of them, including the really bad ones that we don't like to talk about.
zh: 那么在我身上你几乎能给所有的都打上勾,包括那些我们不愿意谈论的非常糟糕的。

speaker: Unknown
en: As bad as that was, when I was 22, 23, I remember being very angry about my childhood.
zh: 尽管那件事那么糟糕,在我 22、23 岁的时候,我记得我对我的童年非常愤怒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Only when I met Rebecca, my then-girlfriend to then-wife, she very quickly introduced me to a spiritual practice.
zh: 直到我遇见 Rebecca,我当时的女朋友、后来的妻子,她很快把我引入了一种灵性修行。

speaker: Unknown
en: The way she introduced me, by the way, was after a week of dating, she came to me and she goes, Look, you're really nice, you have a lot of potential, but you're not the guy for me.
zh: 顺便说一句,她引荐我的方式是,约会一周后,她来找我,她说:听着,你人真的很好,你很有潜力,但你不是适合我的那个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was very surprised at the time.
zh: 我当时非常惊讶。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was living in New York.
zh: 我当时住在纽约。

speaker: Unknown
en: My sister was the supermodel.
zh: 我姐姐是超级模特。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were hanging out.
zh: 我们混在一起玩。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought a lot of myself.
zh: 我自视很高。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, what do you mean I'm not the guy for you?
zh: 于是我说,你什么意思,我不是适合你的那个人?

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, well, you don't have a spiritual band.
zh: 她说,嗯,你没有灵性追求。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're very focused on material things.
zh: 你非常专注于物质的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want to be successful, but you're not actually understanding the game of life.
zh: 你想成功,但你实际上并不理解人生的游戏。

speaker: Unknown
en: The guy I'm interested in is going to want true happiness and true fulfillment.
zh: 我感兴趣的那个人会想要真正的幸福和真正的成就感。

speaker: Unknown
en: And true happiness and true fulfillment does not come from material things.
zh: 而真正的幸福和真正的成就感并不来自物质的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was so different for anything anyone has ever told me, that instead of running away or doing this or doing that, I thought for a second.
zh: 这与我曾经听到的任何话都如此不同,以至于我没有逃跑,没有这样做或那样做,而是想了一秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, well, how would one come to explore this spiritual life that you're talking about?
zh: 我说,嗯,那一个人要怎样来探索你所说的这种灵性生活呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: And she said, well, you need to practice.
zh: 她说,嗯,你需要修行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for me, that practice started being Kabbalah, but for all of us, there can be different practices.
zh: 对我来说,那种修行开始于 Kabbalah(卡巴拉),但对我们每个人来说,修行可以各不相同。

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing I learned very quickly in the practice is the difference between meant to be and free choice.
zh: 我在修行中很快学到的一件事,就是「命中注定」和「自由选择」之间的区别。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think a lot of people don't understand it, but how can there be, we talk a lot about in spiritual, about it's meant to be and there's free choice.
zh: 我觉得很多人不理解它,但怎么可能——我们在灵性里经常谈论「这是命中注定的」以及「存在自由选择」。

speaker: Unknown
en: How could there be free choice and things be meant to be at the same time?
zh: 怎么可能同时存在自由选择,而事情又是命中注定的呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: The way I explain it is you get to a fork in your life.
zh: 我的解释方式是:你走到人生中的一个岔路口。

speaker: Unknown
en: and you choose left over right, and everything works out.
zh: 你选择左而不是右,然后一切都很顺利。

speaker: Unknown
en: Meant to be.
zh: 命中注定。

speaker: Unknown
en: You get to that same fork, and you choose right, and you crash on your face, horribly.
zh: 你走到同一个岔路口,你选择右,然后你摔得脸着地,惨不忍睹。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody's watching.
zh: 所有人都在看着。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you stop, and you actually learn lessons from it.
zh: 而你停下来,并且你真的从中学到了教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you take accountability, and you say, you know what?
zh: 你承担责任,然后你说,你知道吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Whatever happened to me happened for a reason, and I'm gonna learn from it.
zh: 发生在我身上的事都是有原因的,我要从中学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm gonna be stronger.
zh: 我会变得更强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Almost like a sword that's getting forged.
zh: 几乎就像一把正在被锻造的剑。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the more times you hit it, and the more hit you put on it, the stronger it gets.
zh: 你击打它的次数越多,你在它上面留下的捶击越多,它就变得越坚固。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you learn those lessons and you go back into the game of life and you apply that in again.
zh: 然后你学到那些教训,你回到人生的游戏中,再把它应用进去。

speaker: Unknown
en: Suddenly you take the catastrophe or the tragedy or the curse and you make it into a blessing.
zh: 突然之间,你把灾难、悲剧或诅咒变成了祝福。

speaker: Unknown
en: You turn it into a made-to-be.
zh: 你把它变成命中注定。

speaker: Unknown
en: When the world did crash on me as an adult, it was nothing compared to what I had to deal with as a child.
zh: 当成年后世界在我面前崩塌时,与小时候必须面对的事情相比根本不算什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, it's okay.
zh: 我当时想,没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a wife, I have kids, I have close friends.
zh: 我有妻子,我有孩子,我有亲密的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll take a deep breath and we'll start from scratch again.
zh: 我们深吸一口气,然后从头再来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that kind of fortitude, I think regretfully, comes through going through very difficult things.
zh: 而这种坚韧,我想很遗憾,是通过经历非常艰难的事情才获得的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you're listening to this right now and you're going through something really difficult and it feels dark...
zh: 所以如果你现在正在听这些,而你正在经历非常艰难的事情,感觉一片黑暗……

speaker: Unknown
en: I encourage you to remember that the darkest moment of the night is a second before dawn.
zh: 我鼓励你记住,黑夜最黑暗的时刻就是黎明前的一秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel like there's things in your early context that you haven't shared before, because you said there's things that we don't usually share.
zh: 我感觉在你的早期经历背景中有些你以前没有分享过的事情,因为你说有些事情是我们通常不分享的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not publicly, but meaning I have in front of, so I used to share everything in front of our employers that we work.
zh: 不是公开的,而是指在我面前的,所以我以前习惯在我们工作的雇主面前分享一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there's things I shared in front of 10,000 people.
zh: 所以有些事情我在一万个人面前分享过。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not sure it ever made it to the press.
zh: 我不确定那些是否曾被媒体报道过。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is missing?
zh: 缺了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: You really want to go there?
zh: 你真的想去那里吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to go.
zh: 我想去。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm happy to.
zh: 我很乐意。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're happy to, I'm happy to.
zh: 如果你不介意,我也不介意。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll share two things that I'm not sure, but maybe could be helpful for other people that are going through similar things.
zh: 我会分享两件我不太确定、但也许对正在经历类似事情的其他人有帮助的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the hitting and stuff.
zh: 就是那些殴打之类的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so when someone's bipolar, by the way, they get very angry or very happy very fast.
zh: 顺便说一下,当一个人有双相情感障碍时,他们会很快变得非常愤怒或非常开心。

speaker: Unknown
en: When they're happy, they're the happiest.
zh: 当他们开心的时候,他们是最开心的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have fun and everything's amazing.
zh: 你玩得很开心,一切都棒极了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my mom would play games with us and it was phenomenal.
zh: 我妈妈会和我们玩游戏,那非常美好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But...
zh: 但是……

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, and that I think happens a lot with bipolar, there's the suicide threats.
zh: 另外,我想这在双相情感障碍中很常见,就是自杀威胁。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then there's one thing when you threaten to, so again, if you're two children and your only parent threatens to commit suicide, who's going to take care of you?
zh: 然后有一件事,当你威胁要……再说一次,如果你是两个孩子,而你唯一的家长威胁要自杀,谁来照顾你?

speaker: Unknown
en: What is going to happen if suddenly that happens?
zh: 如果突然发生那种事,会怎么样?

speaker: Unknown
en: And I have a lot of memories, but one that just came back to me not too long ago.
zh: 我有很多回忆,但有一个是最近不久才重新浮现在我脑海里的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were in the kibbutz, which is where we were living after we came back from the US.
zh: 我们在基布兹,那是我们从美国回来后住的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: My mom wanted us to have a special experience, so we went to this community where everybody shares a lot of things together.
zh: 我妈妈想让我们有一段特别的经历,所以我们去了这个大家都共享很多东西的社区。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's also the beginning of why I love communities.
zh: 这也是我热爱社区的最初原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we get into this big fight and my mom basically says she's going to kill herself and she takes the knife.
zh: 然后我们大吵了一架,我妈妈基本上说她要自杀,然后她拿起了刀。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember she's holding this huge knife.
zh: 我记得她握着这把巨大的刀。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, no, no, don't do it.
zh: 我说,不,不,别这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember, I just remember feeling that I have to stop it, that it is up to me.
zh: 我记得,我只记得当时感觉我必须阻止它,这取决于我。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if I don't stop it, then she's going to kill herself right there in front, my sister and I.
zh: 而如果我不阻止,她就会当场自杀,就在我和我妹妹面前。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I grabbed the knife and we're fighting left and right.
zh: 所以我抓住了刀,我们左右争斗着。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my sister is sitting right there and she's crying and she's crying.
zh: 我妹妹就坐在那里,她哭着,一直哭。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm no, and she's saying yes, and the whole thing is so crazy.
zh: 而我说不,她说要,整件事太疯狂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: How old were you?
zh: 那时候你多大?

speaker: Unknown
en: Twelve.
zh: 十二岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: At that moment.
zh: 在那一刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's one.
zh: 那是一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's more if you want to go deeper, but that was one.
zh: 如果你想深入,还有更多,但那是一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I invite you to go deeper.
zh: 我邀请你继续深入。

speaker: Unknown
en: I invite you to go deeper.
zh: 我邀请你继续深入。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was in between second grade to fourth grade.
zh: 我当时在二年级到四年级之间。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was sexually, I think you called molested, by an older than a teenager.
zh: 而我被……性方面,我想你称之为猥亵,被一个比……一个青少年。

speaker: Unknown
en: So she was at least six or seven years older than me.
zh: 所以她至少比我大六七岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: This one, I didn't even know that what was happening was wrong.
zh: 这件事,我甚至不知道当时发生的事情是错的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And many years later, Rebecca and I are in the Hamptons.
zh: 许多年后,我和 Rebecca 在汉普顿。

speaker: Unknown
en: And somehow the story comes up.
zh: 然后不知怎么的，这个事就被提起来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she goes, Adam, you understand that this is not normal for a child at that age.
zh: 她说，Adam，你要明白，对一个那个年龄的孩子来说，这是不正常的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I didn't even fully understand.
zh: 而我当时甚至都没有完全理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that taught me.
zh: 那件事教会了我。

speaker: Unknown
en: That explained to me a lot about children.
zh: 它向我解释了很多关于孩子的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And again, we go back to the responsibility of parents and the responsibility of society to take care of the children and schools to understand what's happening.
zh: 再一次，我们要回到父母的责任、社会的责任，去照顾孩子，让学校去理解正在发生的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And whenever we see anyone, we're so good at walking into a room, seeing someone else and judging.
zh: 而每当我们见到任何人时，我们太擅长走进一个房间，看到别人就去评判。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, they're not acting the way I would act.
zh: 哦，他们的行为方式和我不一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not acting right.
zh: 他们表现得不对。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not speaking right.
zh: 他们说话说得不对。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody's so busy judging everybody.
zh: 每个人都忙着评判别人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to encourage every single person next time you're about to judge.
zh: 我想鼓励每一个人，下次你正要评判的时候，

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't know who that person is.
zh: 你不知道那个人是谁。

speaker: Unknown
en: You do not know where they come from.
zh: 你不知道他们来自哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You do not know what happened to them as a kid.
zh: 你不知道他们小时候经历了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: God forbid they were molested.
zh: 天知道他们是否曾被猥亵。

speaker: Unknown
en: God forbid they dealt with all these things.
zh: 天知道他们经历了这一切的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't know where they started.
zh: 你不知道他们从哪里起步。

speaker: Unknown
en: You only know where you see them now.
zh: 你只知道你此刻看到他们的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it could be that if you really got to know them and you'd have known the distance they went from here to here,
zh: 而如果你真正去了解他们，知道他们从这里到这里走过的距离，

speaker: Unknown
en: you would have been extremely impressed with them and you would have not measured them that way.
zh: 你会对他们极为印象深刻，你就不会用那种方式去衡量他们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is why I think it's so important for all of us when we walk into rooms to really go after unity, you and I can say the same sentence in a way that tears people apart or brings people together.
zh: 这就是为什么我认为，我们所有人走进房间时，真正去追求团结是如此重要，你和我可以用同一句话把人们撕开，或者把人们凝聚到一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: It takes more effort to speak in a way that brings us together.
zh: 用一种把我们凝聚在一起的方式说话，需要更多的努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if we don't start acting like this, if we keep dividing and keep splitting, I'm worried.
zh: 但如果我们不开始这样行动，如果我们继续分裂、继续割裂，我很担心。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sounds like as an adult, you've been able to understand that early experience and sort of create a new sort of perspective or lens on what happened to you and what it means.
zh: 听起来作为成年人，你已经能够理解那段早期经历，并某种程度上对发生在你身上的事情以及它的意义形成了一种新的视角或镜头。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as you said, you know, you've orientated it around the fact that it's happened for a reason, or at least there's something to have learned from it.
zh: 正如你所说，你已经把它定位在这样的事实上：它发生是有原因的，或者至少能从中学到些什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Was that always the case?
zh: 一直都是这样吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I sometimes reflect on my own experience and think that for the first season of my life, I was dragged.
zh: 我有时回顾自己的经历，会想到在我人生的第一季里，我是被拖着走的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then at some point, I got hold of the steering wheel and I was able to drive.
zh: 然后在某个时刻，我抓住了方向盘，我能够自己驾驶了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one of them was sort of unconscious and the other was more intentional and thoughtful.
zh: 其中一个算是无意识的，另一个则更有意图、更有思考。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm wondering through your early teens and 20s, whether you had the wisdom and the perspective that you have now on your early experiences and how that's evolved over time.
zh: 我想知道，在你的青少年早期和二十几岁时，你是否对你早期经历拥有像现在这样的智慧和视角，以及这如何随时间演变。

speaker: Unknown
en: I probably went to sleep crying every single night for probably until I was 14 or 15.
zh: 我可能每天晚上都是哭着入睡的，大概一直持续到我十四五岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember, and if you ask my sister, what would I say?
zh: 我记得，如果你问我姐姐，我会说什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I completely forgot.
zh: 我完全忘了。

speaker: Unknown
en: She said, I told her that one day I'll become very successful and we'll take care of us.
zh: 她说，我告诉过她，有一天我会变得非常成功，然后我们会照顾好我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was what I used to say.
zh: 那是我过去常说的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I literally didn't remember.
zh: 我真的不记得了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is something she told me.
zh: 这是她告诉我的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that's how I interpreted that control and how I'm gonna fix all these challenges that I had.
zh: 我想那就是我当时对那种掌控的理解，以及我要如何解决我所面临的这些挑战。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we launched a school, Rebecca and I, more Rebecca I helped, it's a fifth school.
zh: 但我们办了一所学校，我和 Rebecca，更多是 Rebecca，我只是帮忙，这是第五所学校。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the school we teach kids how to be connected to themselves, how to be part of something greater than themselves.
zh: 在学校里我们教孩子们如何与自我连接，如何成为比自己更伟大的事物的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: If someone just taught me this as a kid,
zh: 如果有人在我小时候就教我这个，

speaker: Unknown
en: And I would have understood then that there's this bigger picture.
zh: 那我那时就会明白，还有一幅更大的图景。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think I would have been able to handle it a lot better and skip the challenging years faster.
zh: 我想我本来能更好地应对它，更快地跳过那些艰难的岁月。

speaker: Unknown
en: Move faster into the point where I realize that I don't control what happens, but I can control how I react to it.
zh: 更快地到达我领悟到“我无法控制发生什么，但我可以控制如何回应”的那个节点。

speaker: Unknown
en: So back to your point of driving.
zh: 所以回到你说的驾驶那个点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you driving?
zh: 你在驾驶吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And now you question it, I'm questioning myself.
zh: 现在你提出这个问题，我也在质疑我自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would question it.
zh: 我会质疑它。

speaker: Unknown
en: My follow-up question to you would be, how do you define success?
zh: 我对你的追问会是：你如何定义成功？

speaker: Unknown
en: My definition of success these days, it's funny, I was thinking about it this morning when I got on the lift on my way here.
zh: 我如今对成功的定义，说来有趣，今天早上来这里的路上，上电梯的时候我还在想这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought, do you know what it was?
zh: 我当时想，你知道那是什么吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because my fiancé turned to me this weekend and she went, Stephen, I think you have enough now.
zh: 因为这个周末我的未婚妻转向我说，Stephen,我觉得你已经足够了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then she paused and then she retracted the statement.
zh: 然后她停顿了一下，又收回了这句话。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it got me thinking about what enough is.
zh: 但这让我开始思考什么是「足够」。

speaker: Unknown
en: And actually, I thought, well, it's the motion forward.
zh: 实际上，我想，嗯，就是向前运动。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the pursuit of goals that matter to me, that are challenging, surrounded by people, that is the success.
zh: 在追求对我重要、有挑战性的目标的过程中，身边有一群人，这就是成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's like a daily thing.
zh: 而且这就像是一件每天的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no podium in this game that I'm playing.
zh: 我玩的这场游戏里没有领奖台。

speaker: Unknown
en: By the way, when she said she thinks you have enough, was she referring to material things?
zh: 顺便问一下，当她说觉得你已经足够了的时候，她指的是物质方面的东西吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think society has taught us that once we gain that success, once we gain those material things, we get to this number.
zh: 我认为社会教会我们的是，一旦我们获得了那种成功，一旦我们获得了那些物质的东西，达到了那个数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: Suddenly that hole that we all fill inside of us will be full.
zh: 突然间，我们所有人内心填充的那个洞就会满上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I know it's very hard to hear, especially for people who haven't gotten there yet, like, oh yeah, you got there already, so now you're saying it.
zh: 我知道这很难听进去，尤其是对那些还没到达那个位置的人来说，比如，哦，是啊，你已经到了那个位置，所以你现在才这么说。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm only gonna share with you what I have learned.
zh: 我只会和你分享我学到的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And from all the most successful people that I know, and I'm lucky to know quite a lot of them, I have not seen one that got happy or fulfilled from attaining a number
zh: 在我认识的所有最成功的人当中，我很幸运认识相当多这样的人，我没有见过一个是因为达到了某个数字

speaker: Unknown
en: or a material thing.
zh: 或者某个物质的东西而变得快乐或满足的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't believe that's how the game of life works.
zh: 我不相信人生的游戏是这样运作的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when your fiance said, it's not like her, because I think she's more on the spiritual side.
zh: 那么当你的未婚妻这么说的时候，这不像她，因为我觉得她更偏灵性那一面。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tell her that I said, I'm surprised she said that.
zh: 替我告诉她，她说这话让我很惊讶。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think she had something deeper to say and she was holding back.
zh: 我觉得她有些更深层的想法想说，但她忍住了。

speaker: Unknown
en: When she said, I think you have enough, I would really go back to redefining success.
zh: 当她说「我觉得你已经足够了」的时候，我真想回到重新定义成功这件事上。

speaker: Unknown
en: So back to that, I'll tell you how I define it in a second.
zh: 那就回到这个话题，我一会儿告诉你我是怎么定义的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think if we can agree on the definition of success, then we can start having a discussion of, A, are we there and are we headed there?
zh: 但我认为，如果我们能在成功的定义上达成一致，那么我们就可以开始讨论：A,我们是否已经到达了，我们是否正朝着那里前进？

speaker: Unknown
en: And B, how do we do better to get there?
zh: 还有 B,我们怎样做得更好才能到达那里？

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we agree on our definition of success, then now we can start working together towards the same goal.
zh: 如果我们对成功的定义达成一致，那么现在我们就可以开始朝同一个目标共同努力了。

speaker: Unknown
en: If one of us defines success by making the most money and the other person defines success by being the most fulfilled, the most happy, the most light that they can be, then playing two different games.
zh: 如果我们中的一个把成功定义为赚最多的钱，而另一个人把成功定义为获得最大的满足感、最大的快乐、成为最轻盈的存在，那我们就是在玩两场不同的游戏。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's your definition?
zh: 你的定义是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: When you're at your deathbed and you're one minute before it's all going to go and you know you're out of time, all you have left is the love that surrounds you at that moment.
zh: 当你躺在临终的床上，距离一切结束只剩一分钟，你知道自己的时间不多了，你剩下的只有那一刻围绕在你身边的爱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your children, your grandchildren, your friends, your friends' children, all the love that surrounds you at that moment and all the love that you have cultivated for your entire life.
zh: 你的孩子、你的孙辈、你的朋友、你朋友的孩子，那一刻围绕在你身边所有的爱，以及你一生所培养的所有爱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think it's that love which then moves on to whatever it is that happens after.
zh: 而我认为正是那份爱，之后会继续延续到无论之后发生什么的事情里。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my definition of success is in that last moment, right before you go, how do you feel?
zh: 所以我对成功的定义是，在最后一刻，就在你离去之前，你感觉如何？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you feel full and surrounded by love and like life has been this amazing journey?
zh: 你是否感到充实、被爱包围，觉得人生是一场奇妙的旅程？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or is there regret or is there this?
zh: 还是心中充满遗憾，还是有这样那样的情绪？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll tell you the one thing that happens right before we pass away, the ego goes away completely.
zh: 我来告诉你我们在离世前一刻会发生的一件事，自我完全消失了。

speaker: Unknown
en: No more secrets.
zh: 不再有秘密。

speaker: Unknown
en: And again, in the spiritual study, you say, what's the definition of hell back to how we started this?
zh: 再一次，在灵性修行里，你会问，地狱的定义是什么——回到我们开始这个话题的地方？

zh: 而这就是 WeWork 的初衷。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the idea for WeWork.
zh: 这就是 WeWork 的理念。

speaker: Unknown
en: So sometimes people said, oh, you grew out of desks and chairs.
zh: 所以有时候人们会说，哦，你们是从桌椅起家的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You shouldn't have gone to all these categories.
zh: 你们本不应该涉足这么多品类。

speaker: Unknown
en: The idea started, this was before there was one desk.
zh: 这个想法开始的时候，那时还连一张桌子都没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the essence of this?
zh: 这件事的本质是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: We wanted to make a world, at least in our opinion, that really needed community.
zh: 我们想创造一个，至少在我们看来，真正需要社区的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was to deliver on a mission of create a world where people make a life and not just a living.
zh: 这是为了践行一个使命：创造一个人们不只是谋生、而是在过生活(而不仅是谋生)的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was a full lifestyle life circle.
zh: 这是一个完整的生活方式生活圈。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was very aspirational.
zh: 而且这是非常有抱负的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's how, by the way, for any one of our listeners or your listeners that is starting a business, start with a vision.
zh: 顺便说一下，对于我们或者你的听众中任何正在创业的人来说，要从愿景开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: Dream as high as you can.
zh: 尽可能高地去梦想。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go all the way to the stars.
zh: 一直梦到星星那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if you don't shoot for the stars, you're never going to get to the moon.
zh: 因为如果你不朝星星射，你永远到不了月球。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go far.
zh: 走得远。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then take a deep breath and go back to basics.
zh: 然后深吸一口气，回到基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do I need to do first?
zh: 我首先需要做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What do I need to do second?
zh: 我第二需要做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What do I need to do third?
zh: 我第三需要做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: The secret of life and entrepreneurship is to be able to be in both places at the same time.
zh: 生命与创业的秘诀，就是能够同时身处两个地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the one hand, I'm going to go so far.
zh: 一方面，我要走得那么远。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the other hand, I'm just starting.
zh: 另一方面，我才刚刚起步。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I better roll up my sleeves and get the broom and start brooming.
zh: 所以我最好卷起袖子，拿起扫帚开始扫地。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's both of them.
zh: 两者都要。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need to go knock on doors.
zh: 我需要去敲门。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need to go meet people.
zh: 我需要去见人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need to do whatever work needs to be done at the beginning to get the business started.
zh: 我需要做任何在起步阶段需要做的工作，来让业务启动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk about both then.
zh: 那我们就来聊聊这两者。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you've got the trenches and then you've got, let's say, the clouds or the moon, as you refer to it.
zh: 你有战壕，然后你有，比方说，云层或者月亮，就像你说的那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why is it important to dream big?
zh: 为什么远大的梦想很重要？

speaker: Unknown
en: Why is the scale and the size of the dream important?
zh: 为什么梦想的规模和大小很重要？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I believe it's the secret of manifestation.
zh: 所以我相信这就是显化的秘诀。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when people ask me, Adam, what is the secret of manifestation?
zh: 当人们问我，Adam，显化的秘诀是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you make something out of nothing?
zh: 你如何无中生有地做出一些东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the order is, first you have to believe.
zh: 我认为顺序是，首先你必须相信。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you and I have a big idea, first we have to believe it.
zh: 如果你和我有一个大想法，首先我们必须相信它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then, that takes time to believe.
zh: 然后，相信是需要时间的。

speaker: Unknown
en: True belief, by the way, do you know when belief is measured?
zh: 顺便说一下，真正的信念，你知道信念是在什么时候被衡量的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: When it's really tough.
zh: 在真正艰难的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: Belief is not measured on everything.
zh: 信念不是在一切顺利时被衡量的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I remember this, and I've shared this story before, but your audience is so wide that I'm sure a lot of them haven't heard it.
zh: 所以我记得这个，我以前也分享过这个故事，但你的听众非常广泛，我确定他们中很多人没听过。

speaker: Unknown
en: When right after the whole explosion of WeWork occurred, and it was like five days in and the whole thing was crashing on us and there's a million articles and the whole thing is happening.
zh: 在 WeWork 整个爆雷发生之后，大概五天之后，整个事情都在朝我们崩塌，有上百万篇文章，整个事情都在发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: My spiritual teacher, who I haven't spoken at this point almost for two years after I studied with him for eight years, calls me, said, Adam, how are you doing?
zh: 我的灵性导师——我跟他学习了八年，在那之后我几乎两年没和他说话了——打电话给我，说，Adam，你怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, I'm not doing so well right now.
zh: 我说，我现在过得不太好。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's crazy.
zh: 太疯狂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, oh, great.
zh: 他说，哦，太好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why I called you.
zh: 所以我才给你打电话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, why did you call me?
zh: 我说，你为什么给我打电话？

speaker: Unknown
en: His name is Eitan.
zh: 他叫 Eitan。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, Eitan, why didn't you call me?
zh: 我说，Eitan,你怎么会给我打电话？

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, I called you to make sure that you remember the two things we learned for eight years.
zh: 他说，我打电话是想确认你还记得我们八年里学到的两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, Eitan, we didn't learn two things for eight years.
zh: 我说，Eitan,我们八年里可不是只学了两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We studied twice a week.
zh: 我们每周学习两次。

speaker: Unknown
en: We learned endless things.
zh: 我们学了无数的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, no, you missed it.
zh: 他说，不，你漏掉了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We learned two things.
zh: 我们就学了两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, please remind me.
zh: 我说，请提醒我一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, one was love thy neighbor as yourself and the rest is commentary.
zh: 他说，第一是“爱人如己”，其余的都是注解。

speaker: Unknown
en: I took a second for it.
zh: 我停顿了一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, let's talk about this for a second.
zh: 我说，我们来聊聊这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: What does love thy neighbor as yourself mean to you?
zh: “爱人如己”对你来说意味着什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Such a famous saying.
zh: 这么有名的一句话。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've heard it so many times.
zh: 我们听过无数次了。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I think about it, the way that I understand it is to have empathy and compassion for all of the complexities, both the good, the bad, the indifferent, and that which you don't understand, which is like how I would treat myself.
zh: 当我思考它时，我的理解是对所有的复杂性都抱有同理心和慈悲，无论是好的、坏的、无所谓的，还是你不理解的东西，就像我对待自己那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like I understand that I'm a complex person and that I'm multifaceted and imperfect and that I have strengths and weaknesses and I'm okay with all of it.
zh: 我明白自己是个复杂的人，多面的、不完美的，有优点也有缺点，而我对这一切都能接受。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in others, we're less okay with all of it.
zh: 但对别人，我们就没那么能接受这一切了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Beautiful.
zh: 说得好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's say it a little bit different words, but that was right on.
zh: 用词稍微不同，但完全正确。

speaker: Unknown
en: Love the Emperor as yourself means that you first have to love yourself.
zh: “爱人如己”的意思是你首先必须爱自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: To love yourself, you have to acknowledge not only the great strength that you have that you love, you must acknowledge your weaknesses, your failures, your mistakes.
zh: 要爱自己，你不仅要承认你拥有的、你喜爱的那些巨大优点，你还必须承认你的弱点、你的失败、你的错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the only way you can love yourself after all of those is if you're able to forgive yourself.
zh: 而在那一切之后你还能爱自己的唯一办法，就是你能原谅自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the true secret of loving oneself is to forgive yourself, to not carry guilt, to really be able to know that all of these are lessons for you to grow and change and go to your next level from.
zh: 所以爱自己的真正秘诀是原谅自己，不背负内疚，真正能够明白，这一切都是让你成长、改变、迈向下一个台阶的功课。

speaker: Unknown
en: Back to the sword analogy.
zh: 回到那把剑的比喻。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're a sword and you're getting forged and every single time you get hit, you just get stronger.
zh: 你是一把正在被锻造的剑，每一次被击打，你都会变得更强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Once you feel that and you're able to love yourself, then you're able to love everybody else.
zh: 一旦你体会到这一点，能够爱自己，那你就能爱所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was the first thing he told me we learned.
zh: 那是他告诉我我们学到的第一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second thing he said to me, which we said before, is I want to remind you that the darkest moment of the night is the second before dawn.
zh: 他对我说的第二件事，我们之前也说过，就是我想提醒你，夜晚最黑暗的时刻是黎明前的那一刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: Belief is not measured on everything is going up and everybody's telling you what a genius you are and everybody wants to be your friend and everybody wants to be your investor.
zh: 信念不是在一帆风顺、所有人都说你是天才、所有人都想成为你的朋友、所有人都想当你的投资人的时候来衡量的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Belief is measured when it's all crashing.
zh: 信念是在一切都崩溃的时候来衡量的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Belief.
zh: 信念。

speaker: Unknown
en: when even your friends are questioning you, when the phone is not ringing.
zh: 当连你的朋友都在质疑你，当电话不再响起的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if a person is able to have true belief then, then he says to me, if you're going to be able to take this experience and really hold your belief, hold your positivity, hold your happiness, be the person I know you can be, you can't imagine what the future is stored for you.
zh: 而如果一个人那时还能拥有真正的信念，他对我说，如果你能带着这段经历，真正守住你的信念、守住你的积极、守住你的快乐，成为我知道你能成为的那个人，你无法想象未来为你准备了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: What did you believe in, in your hardest moment?
zh: 在你最艰难的时刻，你相信的是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: in God, and in myself, in my wife, in my kids, and in the fact that even though I don't know at this moment why this thing happened, I am going to be stronger for it.
zh: 相信上帝，相信我自己，相信我的妻子，相信我的孩子们，相信即使此刻我不知道这件事为何发生，我也会因此变得更强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember that morning, this phone call was late at night.
zh: 我记得那天早上，那通电话是深夜打来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next morning at 6 a.m., I walked down to...
zh: 第二天早上六点，我走到……

speaker: Unknown
en: to my three, I went from 13,000 employees to three employees in one week.
zh: 走到我的三个人那里，我从一个星期内的 13000 名员工变成了三个员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: I walked down to the three employees who were my partners in the family office, not even employees, partners.
zh: 我走到那三个员工面前，他们是我家族办公室的合伙人，甚至不只是员工，是合伙人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I walked down to them and I'm smiling.
zh: 我走向他们，我微笑着。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're stressed out.
zh: 他们压力很大。

speaker: Unknown
en: We would meet every day at 6 a.m. that we're done.
zh: 我们每天早上六点见面，那时我们已经完了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're bankrupt.
zh: 我们破产了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's finished.
zh: 结束了。

speaker: Unknown
en: They only joined me three months before they came to manage what they thought was a five to $10 billion family office.
zh: 他们只在我加入前三个月才认识我，他们来管理的是他们以为的一家五十亿到一百亿美元的家族办公室。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they're dealing with negative 400 million compounding interest, full bankruptcy situation.
zh: 而他们面对的是负四亿的复利利息，彻底的破产局面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I thought about them all my, not all, a lot of friends that I had that were really there with me and enjoyed with me and grew with me and made money with me.
zh: 而我想到了他们，我所有的——不是所有，很多朋友，那些真正陪在我身边、和我一起享受、和我一起成长、和我一起赚钱的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I really needed that one small moment, a lot of them weren't there.
zh: 当我真正需要那一个小小的时刻时，他们中的很多人都不在。

speaker: Unknown
en: And these three almost strangers who I didn't really know were standing right there by my side.
zh: 而这三个我其实并不认识的几乎算陌生人的人，就站在我身边。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they see me smiling, I say, Adam, why are you smiling?
zh: 他们看到我在笑，他们说，Adam,你为什么在笑？

speaker: Unknown
en: They're like, they thought I really lost my mind.
zh: 他们觉得，他们以为我真的疯了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was done.
zh: 一切都完了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, I'm smiling because I remember that the darkest moment of the night is a second before dawn.
zh: 然后我说，我在笑是因为我记得，黑夜最黑暗的时刻就是黎明前一秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember that belief is actually measured when things are difficult, not when everything is working.
zh: 而且我记得，信念其实是在事情困难的时候才被衡量的，不是在一切顺利的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I believe, and I know it's going to work out, and I don't know how, and I don't know why, but this is all going to work out for the best.
zh: 而我相信，我知道事情会好起来的，我不知道怎么好起来，我也不知道为什么，但这一切最终都会好起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're going to learn a lot from this, and it will actually prepare us when a real difficulty happens, so we're ready to go and deal with it.
zh: 而且我们会从中学到很多，这其实会为我们将来真正的困难做好准备，让我们能够随时去应对它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And about 10 days later, we started coming out of it in a very positive way.
zh: 大约十天后，我们开始以非常积极的方式走出困境。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to go to the top of the story, because I really want to walk through some of the key moments.
zh: 我想回到故事的开头，因为我真的很想梳理几个关键时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I noticed your energy shift a little bit when you started describing those three people.
zh: 但我注意到，当你开始描述那三个人时，你的能量有了一点变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's another thing that I've learned.
zh: 这是我学到的另一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you now haven't, you're facing this as we speak right now.
zh: 如果你现在还没有——你此刻就正在面对这种情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: I bet you have lots of friends.
zh: 我打赌你有很多朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: I bet you have lots of friends.
zh: 我打赌你有很多朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's how you define friends.
zh: 你就是这样定义朋友的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Exactly.
zh: 没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I'll tell you a secret about them.
zh: 好吧，我来告诉你一个关于他们的秘密。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm sorry to say that.
zh: 我很抱歉这么说。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're only going to know which one of them are your friend and which ones are not.
zh: 只有到了那一步，我们才会知道他们当中谁是你的朋友，谁不是。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where if, God forbid, you crash and you actually need them.
zh: 就是如果——但愿不会——你垮掉了，你真正需要他们的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I can also tell you if you're going to crash or not.
zh: 而且我还可以告诉你，你会不会垮掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you go big enough, really, really big, you crash.
zh: 如果你做得足够大，真的、真的足够大，你就会垮掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: Whenever someone tells you, oh, Adam, it's never going to happen to me.
zh: 每当有人对你说，哦，Adam,这种事绝不会发生在我身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: My ego is never going to get the best of me.
zh: 我的自我永远不会压倒我。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm never, I'm always going to stay in control.
zh: 我永远不会，我永远会保持掌控。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a young, successful people like to say that to me.
zh: 我有很多年轻、成功的人喜欢对我说这种话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say, oh, you haven't gone big enough.
zh: 我会说，哦，你还做得不够大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if you really, really, that's part of the definition of going really, really big.
zh: 因为如果你真的、真的——那正是“做得真的、真的很大”这个定义的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: Life is not about...
zh: 人生不是关于……

speaker: Unknown
en: If we fall down, we're supposed to fall down.
zh: 如果我们跌倒了，我们本来就应该跌倒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Life is about how we get up.
zh: 人生在于我们如何站起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the more times we fall down, the more times we get to get up.
zh: 而且我们跌倒的次数越多，我们就有越多的机会站起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you practice getting up enough times, then you might not fall.
zh: 如果你练习站起来足够多次，那么你可能就不会跌倒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then you get very good at it.
zh: 那时你会变得非常擅长这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you can go and really go for the stars.
zh: 然后你就可以去真正地摘星星了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So with the friends, the reason my energy changed about those three, I didn't know them that well.
zh: 所以关于那几个朋友，我的能量之所以变化，是因为我对那三个人并不那么了解。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they stuck by me.
zh: 而他们坚定地站在我身边。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a weakness with loyalty.
zh: 我在忠诚这件事上有个软肋。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm very loyal.
zh: 我非常忠诚。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you were there for me when things were tough, I'm a sucker for that.
zh: 所以如果你在事情艰难的时候陪在我身边，我对此毫无抵抗力。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll be there for you, even if you mess up, to a fault almost.
zh: 我就会陪在你身边，即使你搞砸了，几乎到了不顾一切的程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of founders who start businesses have this thing that pop culture is called imposter syndrome, where they kind of do doubt themselves.
zh: 很多创业者都有一种流行文化称之为“冒名顶替综合征”的东西，他们多少会怀疑自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this sort of sits in contrast to this idea of having belief, because sometimes they don't believe, and they are plagued with insecurities and doubts, and they kind of go back and forward, and they think, really, am I the person to do this?
zh: 而这和拥有信念的理念似乎形成了一种对照，因为有时他们并不相信，他们被不安全感和怀疑所困扰，他们会来来回回地想，真的吗，我真的是做这件事的人吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I've never done it before.
zh: 我以前从没做过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is, that comes with pursuing something great.
zh: 而这正是追求伟大事业所伴随的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You had never done it before.
zh: 你以前从来没有做过。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what do you say to those people who are struggling with doubt?
zh: 那么你对那些正在与怀疑作斗争的人说什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because they're hearing, listen, you have to believe.
zh: 因为他们听到的是：听着，你必须相信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you have doubt when you drew this?
zh: 当你画下这个的时候，你有怀疑吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: The fascinating question.
zh: 这个问题很有意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: My level of certainty was so high when I was doing WeWork.
zh: 我做 WeWork 的时候，我的确定程度非常高。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was sure it was going to work.
zh: 我确信它会成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of times I think people confused my certainty as a different word.
zh: 很多时候，我觉得人们把我的确定误解成了另一个词。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was just, I was that sure that the product is needed for the world.
zh: 我就是，我就是那么确信这个世界需要这个产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I started Flow, which was different and came after everything and after also we had a family.
zh: 当我创办 Flow 的时候，情况不同了，那是在这一切之后，也是在我们有了家庭之后。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I started work I had no kids.
zh: 我开始工作的时候还没有孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was just Rebecca and I.
zh: 当时只有我和 Rebecca。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was very easy to throw myself into something and work 18 to 20 hour days, seven days a week and love every second.
zh: 那时候很容易把自己投入到一件事里，每周七天、每天工作 18 到 20 个小时，并且热爱每一秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was nothing else.
zh: 没有别的了。

speaker: Unknown
en: WeWork grew astronomically quickly, really atypically quickly, especially for that type of company.
zh: WeWork 增长得极其迅速，真的不同寻常地快，尤其是对那种类型的公司而言。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I wanted to hear directly from you, why?
zh: 我想直接听你说，为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What happened?
zh: 发生了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What were the factors that contributed to this meteoric rise?
zh: 是哪些因素促成了这次惊人的崛起？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think a couple of years after you founded the company, I became a customer of it.
zh: 我记得在你创立公司几年后，我成为了它的客户。

speaker: Unknown
en: both in New York, but also in London.
zh: 在纽约，也在伦敦。

speaker: Unknown
en: What didn't I see?
zh: 我没看到的是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: What was it?
zh: 那是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: So WeWork started in February of 2010.
zh: WeWork 始于 2010 年 2 月。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's, for anybody listening, I think this is the way that it should and could work.
zh: 对任何在听的人来说，我认为这就是它应该且可以运作的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think from the first day, we were so clear, as you pointed out with The Circle, on the fact that this mission is bigger than us.
zh: 我认为从第一天起，正如你用 The Circle 指出的那样，我们就非常清楚这个使命比我们自身更大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you're part of a mission that's greater than yourself, urgency doesn't just become something like, oh, we have to do it now because I said so or because we said so.
zh: 当你是某个比自己更伟大的使命的一部分时，紧迫感就不只是那种“哦，我们现在必须做，因为我这么说了，或者因为我们这么说了”。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you feel that your mission really needs to come out to the world, then you have to do it now because there's no time to waste because it's really important.
zh: 当你觉得你的使命真的需要展现给世界时，那你就必须现在就做，因为没有时间可以浪费，因为它真的很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we just started with our first.
zh: 然后我们就从我们的第一个……开始了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And part of my energy is I bring people together.
zh: 我能量的一部分就是把人们聚在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really like creating community.
zh: 我真的很喜欢创建社区。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I also, I love to move fast when we're clear on the direction that we're moving.
zh: 但同时，当我们对前进的方向很清晰时，我喜欢快速行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I don't believe anything is impossible.
zh: 而且我不相信有任何事情是不可能的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when you connect that mission of something being greater than yourself, speed and not accepting a no, you put those things together, then real magic happens.
zh: 所以当你把那个比自己更伟大的使命、速度、以及不接受“不”这些连接在一起时，真正的魔法就会发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that's one too.
zh: 我认为这也是其中之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want an example of that.
zh: 我想要一个例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll give you one.
zh: 我给你一个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Many examples, but let's start.
zh: 例子很多，但我们先开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's start early WeWork, because I think this all started weird.
zh: 我们从早期的 WeWork 开始，因为我觉得这一切都始于一种奇怪的状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: But before the example, one more thing I was going to say that made WeWork to answer a question.
zh: 但在例子之前，还有一点我本来要说，用它来回答这个问题，是什么造就了 WeWork。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the team.
zh: 是团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: The team was so dedicated.
zh: 团队是如此投入。

speaker: Unknown
en: The team believed so much.
zh: 团队如此相信。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was their...
zh: 那是他们的……

speaker: Unknown
en: It was their essence.
zh: 那是他们的本质。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was their experience of being part of something greater than themselves.
zh: 那是他们作为比自己更伟大的事物一部分的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you can bring a group of people together to all run in the same direction, you almost can't stop anything.
zh: 而当你能把一群人聚在一起朝同一个方向奔跑时，你几乎无法阻止任何事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll give you an example.
zh: 我给你一个例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's our second WeWork building.
zh: 那是我们的第二栋 WeWork 大楼。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to do the floor.
zh: 我们需要做地板。

speaker: Unknown
en: We only had $90,000.
zh: 我们只有 9 万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't have any more money.
zh: 我们已经没有钱了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all the quotes were $200,000 a floor, whatever the number was.
zh: 所有报价都是每层地板 20 万美元，不管具体数字是多少。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said to Miguel and to the few people there, we have to do it for this price.
zh: 我对 Miguel 和在场的几个人说，我们必须按这个价格做。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, you can't.
zh: 我说，你们不能。

speaker: Unknown
en: We got five quotes.
zh: 我们拿到了五份报价。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not the price.
zh: 这不是价格的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, well, how much is the floor?
zh: 我说，那地板要多少钱？

speaker: Unknown
en: And everybody's like, the floor is between 30,000 to 45,000 where these wood floors was an important part of the design.
zh: 大家都说，地板价格在 3 万到 4.5 万美元之间，这些木地板是设计中很重要的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, why?
zh: 我说，为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, what do you mean, why?
zh: 我说，你说“为什么”是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: These are the quotes.
zh: 这些就是报价。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, well, can you break down the quote for me?
zh: 我说，那你能把报价给我分解一下吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, what do you mean?
zh: 我说，你这是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, well, how many pieces of floor?
zh: 我说，那要多少块地板？

speaker: Unknown
en: How many nails?
zh: 多少颗钉子？

speaker: Unknown
en: How much glue?
zh: 多少胶水？

speaker: Unknown
en: How much rubber?
zh: 多少橡胶？

speaker: Unknown
en: How many hours of work per person?
zh: 每个人要工作多少小时？

speaker: Unknown
en: How much does each person cost?
zh: 每个人的成本是多少？

speaker: Unknown
en: No one could answer.
zh: 没有人能回答。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I have an idea of how we can negotiate this differently.
zh: 于是我有了一个如何用不同方式来谈判的想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: I called the top three guys and said, I would like you to earn 15% above the cost.
zh: 我打电话给排名前三的承包商，说，我希望你们在成本之上赚 15%。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that's a fair margin, 15%.
zh: 我觉得 15% 是一个合理的利润率。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you agree?
zh: 你们同意吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So of course I agree.
zh: 所以我当然同意。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, great.
zh: 就像，太好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all three of them, by the way, said yes.
zh: 顺便说一下，他们三个都答应了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, great.
zh: 我说，太好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I'm going to need to see the cost of each piece.
zh: 那我需要看到每一项的成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to go quote it myself.
zh: 我会自己去询价。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to get to 15%.
zh: 我会算到 15%。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very quickly, the cost went down to that first floor.
zh: 很快，成本就降到了最初那层地板的价。

speaker: Unknown
en: Instead of $30,000 to $45,000, it was $12,000.
zh: 不是 3 万到 4.5 万美元，而是 1.2 万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: The guy who touched me, Adam, no one's ever worked with me that way.
zh: 那个跟我打过交道的家伙，Adam，从来没有人这样跟我合作过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before you know it, they joined us and we had our own internal construction company.
zh: 不知不觉中，他们加入了我们，我们有了自己的内部建筑公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we realized that only by controlling it could we get the right price and we're fast enough.
zh: 我们意识到，只有自己掌控，才能拿到合适的价格，而且我们的速度才够快。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's not taking no for an answer, but also using logic to really look into it.
zh: 所以这不只是不接受“不行”这个答案，还要用逻辑去真正深入调查。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, it could be that if I looked into it, I wouldn't have been able to get a better price.
zh: 当然，也可能我去调查之后，也拿不到更好的价格。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what I'm describing is the challenge in construction in general and globally.
zh: 但我所描述的，是建筑行业整体的、全球性的挑战。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's part of the things that flow is solving today.
zh: 而这也是 flow 今天正在解决的问题之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Elon would call that like reasoning from first principles.
zh: Elon 会把这称为从第一性原理出发进行推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had a similar story.
zh: 我也有一个类似的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: He would.
zh: 他会这么叫的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He would call it like that.
zh: 他确实会那样称呼它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And from what I know...
zh: 据我所知……

speaker: Unknown
en: In flow, we look up to Ilan as an entrepreneur.
zh: 在 flow，我们把 Ilan 视为创业者的榜样。

speaker: Unknown
en: We think he's unbelievable.
zh: 我们认为他不可思议。

speaker: Unknown
en: And whenever someone gives Ilan as an example, say, no one is Ilan.
zh: 但每当有人拿 Ilan 举例时，我会说，没有人能成为 Ilan。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not an example we use.
zh: 那不是我们使用的例子。

speaker: Unknown
en: We just, we look at him for inspiration.
zh: 我们只是从他那获得启发。

speaker: Unknown
en: I happen to know that he can put an engineer, because I have a friend whose daughter works for him in SpaceX, he can put an engineer to work on one problem for six months, one screw, one connection, but the result ends up being not twice as simple as anything NASA has done, but like 500 times as simple, and cheaper, and faster, and lighter.
zh: 我恰好知道，他可以让一名工程师——因为我有个朋友，他的女儿在 SpaceX 为他工作——让一名工程师在一个问题上工作六个月，一颗螺丝、一个连接件，但最终的结果不是比 NASA 做过的任何东西简单两倍，而是简单大约 500 倍，而且更便宜、更快、更轻。

speaker: Unknown
en: So yes, it's going back.
zh: 所以，是的，它会回到这一点上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can call it first principles.
zh: 你可以称之为第一性原理。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can call it asking every question.
zh: 你可以称之为把每个问题都问一遍。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you're the entrepreneur and you're going to run, or if you're an employee or a partner, ask why.
zh: 但如果你是那个要去打拼的企业家，或者你是一名员工或合伙人，去问为什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: People don't because they don't want to be rude or inconvenience others or they're too concerned with being liked.
zh: 人们不问，是因为他们不想显得无礼、不想给别人添麻烦，或者太在意自己是否被人喜欢。

speaker: Unknown
en: So pushing back on a supplier or, you know, conventional status quo in any way is seen to be inconvenient.
zh: 所以，以任何方式反驳一个供应商，或者反驳某种传统现状，都会被视为添麻烦。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to try to say a different reason why they're not.
zh: 我打算试着说一个不同的原因，说明他们为什么不问。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because they don't ask themselves why.
zh: 但我们肩负着一项使命。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's going to go back.
zh: 它会回到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: This discussion can keep going back to the same basics.
zh: 这个讨论可以一直回到同样的基本点上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: A person who's comfortable asking himself, why is he doing something?
zh: 一个习惯于问自己“我为什么要做这件事”的人，

speaker: Unknown
en: Questioning himself or herself, seeing negative things, seeing problems, and then enjoying the process of growing out of them, will have no problem asking someone else why.
zh: 质疑他自己或她自己，看到负面的东西、看到问题，然后享受从中成长的过程，那么他去问别人为什么就不会有任何问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And whenever you ask someone why and they don't want to answer you, what are you hiding?
zh: 而每当你问别人为什么、而对方不想回答你时——你在隐藏什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a discussion.
zh: 这是一场讨论。

speaker: Unknown
en: I usually, when I go into topics like this, start by telling the vendor, wherever it is, I want you to make money.
zh: 我通常在进入这类话题时，会先告诉供应商——不管它是谁——我要你赚钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one's trying to make you lose money.
zh: 没有人想让你亏钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we're on a mission.
zh: 但我们肩负使命。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if I'm going to pay even 20% more than I should, then that's 20% less of another building, another community, another neighborhood that Flo is not going to take part in.
zh: 如果我要付出哪怕比我应付的多 20%，那就意味着另外 20% 的另一栋楼、另一个社区、另一个街区是 Flo 无法参与的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This really does make a lot of sense to me.
zh: 这对我来说真的非常有道理。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have this Slack channel in our company called Paper Walls.
zh: 我们公司有一个 Slack 频道，叫 Paper Walls(纸墙)。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the whole idea is that we're trying to encourage our team to push on paper walls.
zh: 整个理念就是，我们鼓励团队去推那些纸墙。

speaker: Unknown
en: A paper wall is something that looks solid, but reveals itself to be completely made of paper the minute you try it.
zh: 纸墙就是那种看起来很坚固、但你一推它就显出完全是用纸做的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You ask why, you push on it.
zh: 你去问为什么，你去推它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's a story of a kid that worked for me in one of my companies for four years, and he animates video.
zh: 有个故事，一个为我工作过四年的孩子，在我的一家公司里，他是做视频动画的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said to him, how long is it going to take you to animate a video for us?
zh: 我对他说，你为我们的一个视频做动画要多久？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's 30 minutes.
zh: 那是 30 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said it takes nine days.
zh: 他说要九天。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right?
zh: 对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: He worked for me for four years.
zh: 他为我工作了四年。

speaker: Unknown
en: It took him nine days to hang out the video.
zh: 他花了九天来做完那个视频。

speaker: Unknown
en: We decide we want to launch a weekly channel.
zh: 我们决定要推出一个每周更新的频道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need him to do it in three or four days max so that the rest of the team can do it.
zh: 我需要他最多在三到四天内完成，这样团队其他人才能跟上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say to him, how long is it going to take you?
zh: 我对他说，你要花多久？

speaker: Unknown
en: He says nine days.
zh: 他说九天。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then because we'd established this culture in our company of pushing on paper walls, I said to him, why?
zh: 然后，因为我们在公司里建立了一种推纸墙的文化，我对他说，为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you know what he said to me?
zh: 你知道他对我说了什么吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think I said something like, what would it take to do it in two?
zh: 我记得我说的大概是，要在两天内做到需要什么条件？

speaker: Unknown
en: And he went, Stephen, you just need to buy me a new laptop.
zh: 然后他去了，说：Stephen,你只需要给我买一台新笔记本电脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have an old laptop.
zh: 我有一台旧笔记本。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought, fucking hell, I've been paying him for four years.
zh: 我心想，见鬼，我已经给他付了四年的薪水。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's been, think about how much time I've lost in those four years, just simply because I didn't ask that question.
zh: 而他也一直——想想这四年里我损失了多少时间，仅仅因为我没有问那个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: But also to your point, he never mentioned it.
zh: 但同样，正如你所说，他自己从来没提过这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: He never knew he was in a paper wall himself.
zh: 他从来不知道他自己就身处一堵纸墙之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: First year of WeWork, we opened one building.
zh: WeWork 的第一年，我们开了 一栋楼。

speaker: Unknown
en: Year nine of WeWork, we opened two buildings a day.
zh: WeWork 的第九年，我们一天开两栋楼。

speaker: Unknown
en: in 130 cities, 50 countries, 70 languages, 100,000 square foot per building.
zh: 在 130 个城市、50 个国家、70 种语言，每栋楼 100,000 平方英尺。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's 200,000 square foot a day, 20,000 square meter for your European listeners a day.
zh: 也就是说一天 200,000 平方英尺，换算一下是每天 20,000 平方米，给你们的欧洲听众一个参照。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of the same people who are only capable doing the one and two participants, were leaders by that time, of being able to do one of the fastest physical global growth the world's ever seen.
zh: 很多当初只能做一栋、两栋楼的同一批人，到那时已经成为了领导者，实现了世界上有史以来最快的实体全球增长之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Same people.
zh: 同一批人。

speaker: Unknown
en: As you learn to, in your words, go through paper rolls, as you learn that anything is possible, suddenly this is the secret of high growth and momentum.
zh: 当你学会,用你的话说,穿越纸卷,当你学会一切皆有可能,突然间这就是高增长和势头的秘密。

speaker: Unknown
en: Whatever you can do today, if your company starts growing fast, you'll be shocked what you'll be able to do in three months, nine months.
zh: 无论你今天能做什么,如果你的公司开始快速增长,三个月后、九个月后你能做到什么,你会大吃一惊。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in two years, you're going to look back and not believe that that was your capacity.
zh: 两年后,你回头会不敢相信那就是你当时的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I keep telling people, and they tell me, oh, I can't do this, and this takes three months.
zh: 我一直跟人说,他们跟我说,哦,这个我做不了,这要三个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say, guys, I've seen this done before.
zh: 我说,各位,我以前见过这种事被做成。

speaker: Unknown
en: Forget I know we can do it.
zh: 因为围绕努力工作确实存在一场争论。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's easier now.
zh: 现在更容易了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've already been there.
zh: 我已经去过那里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now you just need to believe.
zh: 现在你只需要相信。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it goes back to the belief.
zh: 这又回到了信念。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we're going to need to put the systems and the processes.
zh: 然后我们就需要建立系统和流程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And today with technology, and this is where I think AI is very exciting, you could shortcut a lot of these things and do a much better work.
zh: 而今天有了技术,这也是我觉得 AI 令人非常兴奋的地方,你可以抄近路把其中很多事情做得好得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: But back to what you said about your company, I bet, when's the last time you sat with them in a circle?

en: When you stop for a second and look what you did, like, wow, we did quite a lot in three months.

speaker: Unknown
en: So very useful.

en: We put together our board decks.

en: We send them to them a few days before.

en: They actually read them.

en: And then they come for the meeting.

en: So it's like 8.30 to 5.

en: And the dinner starts by me saying, we sit down, usually wherever it is.
zh: 晚饭开始时我会说,我们坐下来,通常不管在哪儿。

en: Please tell me what I can do better.

en: And the first time I asked them, they were a little bit uncomfortable.

en: The second time, I literally remember Mark going like this, Mark Andreessen, like this, like he was ready.

speaker: Unknown
en: Ben taking out his notes.

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a true partnership.

en: And we do it every single time.

en: And when you have the previous, you said some of the biggest investors, in my opinion, A16Z, number one investor on the planet.

zh: 如果你今天是创业者,你从 Benchmark 拿钱,就是那家把我投出来的公司,把 Travis 这样的巨星投出来的,把 Jack Dorsey 投出来的。

en: Travis from Uber.

en: Travis from Uber.

en: So when you choose your investors, look at their history.
zh: 所以当你选择投资人时,看看他们的历史。

en: Are they the kind that support entrepreneurs like you?
zh: 他们是不是那种支持像你这样的创业者的人?

en: Yeah.

en: If they have a history that clashes with the entrepreneur, park them.

en: So there was two key things I pulled out from there.

en: The first was around this idea of like knowing when to go fast and slow and use technology as an example.
zh: 第一个是关于知道何时该快、何时该慢这个想法，并以技术为例。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second thing, which opened up the story about A16Z, is the right people and partners.
zh: 第二件事，也就是引出了关于 A16Z 那段故事的，是对的人和伙伴。

speaker: Unknown
en: So important.
zh: 非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: More.
zh: 继续说。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I had to choose one, right investors, right employees, right partners, most important thing.
zh: 如果我只能选一个的话——对的投资者、对的员工、对的伙伴，是最重要的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: What did you learn about employees?
zh: 关于员工你学到了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, what is a great team member?
zh: 比如，什么是优秀的团队成员？
