en: If I have a problem with an employee, there's only one person to blame.
zh: 如果我对某个员工有问题，只有一个可以责怪的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's me.
zh: 那就是我自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what are the mistakes that you made in choosing employees?
zh: 那么你在选择员工上犯过哪些错误？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's how I was leading that I've been learning more about.
zh: 我觉得是关于我如何领导的，这一点我一直在学习更多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where I used to lead from top to bottom, I now am learning how to lead bottom to up.
zh: 我过去是自上而下地领导，现在我在学习如何自下而上地领导。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the difference?
zh: 区别是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Top to bottom means you think because someone reports into you, they have to do what you say.
zh: 自上而下意味着你认为因为某人向你汇报，他们就必须按你说的做。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's not true.
zh: 但这不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is not a dictatorship.
zh: 这不是独裁。

speaker: Unknown
en: They have free will.
zh: 他们有自由意志。

speaker: Unknown
en: They can go work.
zh: 他们可以离开去工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you hired someone that's really talented, they'll go work elsewhere, especially great lead.
zh: 如果你雇了真正有才华的人，他们会去别处工作，尤其是优秀的领导者。

speaker: Unknown
en: The more talented they are, the more the top to bottom does not work.
zh: 他们越有才华，自上而下就越行不通。

speaker: Unknown
en: They won't be willing to do it.
zh: 他们不会愿意这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: They shouldn't.
zh: 他们也不应该。

speaker: Unknown
en: Great talent is not willing to be managed like this.
zh: 伟大的人才不愿意被这样管理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Great talent wants to be inspired, wants me to see the full version of themselves even more than they see it.
zh: 伟大的人才想要被激励，想让我看到他们完整的版本，甚至超过他们自己看到的程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they want the room to make mistakes, but also to grow.
zh: 而且他们想要犯错的余地，同时也想成长。

speaker: Unknown
en: But they also need feedback.
zh: 但他们也需要反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have someone amazing and they're fucking up, sorry, they're missed.
zh: 如果你有一个很棒的人，而他们正在搞砸，抱歉，他们正在搞砸。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can swear.
zh: 你可以说脏话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can swear.
zh: 我可以说脏话。

speaker: Unknown
en: My kids are going to listen.
zh: 我的孩子会听的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all good.
zh: 没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're fucking up.
zh: 他们正在搞砸。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you going to tell them?
zh: 你会告诉他们吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or because you're not comfortable with conflict, you're going to wait for 90 days.
zh: 还是说你因为不习惯冲突，要等 90 天。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every time they're going to make that mistake, you're going to get so upset that by the time you communicate to them, it's too late.
zh: 而且每次他们犯那个错误，你都会非常生气，以至于等到你和他们沟通的时候，已经太晚了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The moment they made a mistake, if you respect them, give them the feedback because that's the best thing for them.
zh: 在他们犯错的那一刻，如果你尊重他们，就给他们反馈，因为那是对他们最好的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: By the way, when you give them the feedback, give them room to give you feedback.
zh: 顺便说一句，当你给他们反馈时，也留出余地让他们给你反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're going to manage these employees and you want to attract the best talent in the world,
zh: 如果你要管理这些员工，并且你想吸引全世界最顶尖的人才，

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember that power comes from influence, not control.
zh: 记住，权力来自影响力，而不是控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you think they need to do what you said because you're their boss, you've already lost.
zh: 如果你认为他们必须按你说的做，因为你是他们的老板，那你已经输了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's a matter of time until it doesn't work out.
zh: 只是时间问题，直到事情行不通。

speaker: Unknown
en: If they're okay with it, just because you're the boss, you have to tell them what they do and they accept that power.
zh: 如果他们接受了，只因为你是老板，你就必须告诉他们做什么，而他们接受了那种权力，

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not the right employee for you and you're not the right boss for them.
zh: 那他们不是适合你的员工，你也不是适合他们的老板。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no chance you're getting the best out of them.
zh: 你绝不可能从他们身上得到最好的表现。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the parts in your journey that I have reflected on a lot, because it's a fascinating story, is the day that you meet Massa at SoftBank.
zh: 在你的旅程中，有一个部分我反复思考过，因为那是一个很精彩的故事，就是你与软银的 Massa 会面的那一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm keen to understand the context of where the business was before you met Massa at SoftBank.
zh: 我很想了解在你见到软银的 Masa 之前,公司当时处于什么样的境况。

speaker: Unknown
en: That particular story has always inspired me for a multitude of different reasons.
zh: 那个故事一直激励着我,原因有很多。

speaker: Unknown
en: But where was the business at?
zh: 但当时公司处于什么状态?

speaker: Unknown
en: Was it, what, 2017?
zh: 是,哪一年来着,2017 年?

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to tell you about the day I met Masa and I'm going to connect it to, I think, the biggest mistake I ever made in WeWork.
zh: 我想跟你讲讲我见到 Masa 的那一天,并且我会把它和我认为我在 WeWork 犯下的最大错误联系起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll bring it together.
zh: 我会把这一切串起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa is one of the best investors in the world.
zh: Masa 是世界上最优秀的投资人之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's also one of the biggest investors in the world.
zh: 他也是世界上规模最大的投资人之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: In my story, Masa is the hero, even though a lot of people who didn't know the story correctly might have misunderstood.
zh: 在我的故事里,Masa 是英雄,尽管很多不了解真实故事的人可能产生了误解。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in my story, Masa took a bet on me and he did amazing and he deserved to have become very successful from it.
zh: 所以在我的故事里,Masa 押注了我,他做得非常出色,他也理应从中获得巨大的成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he leads SoftBank.
zh: 而且他领导着软银。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa is the leader of SoftBank.
zh: Masa 是软银的领导者。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you want a little history of Masa, Masa is the leader of SoftBank.
zh: 所以如果你想了解一点 Masa 的历史,Masa 是软银的领导者。

speaker: Unknown
en: He becomes very well known to the world where he buys a tech conference actually in Vegas.
zh: 他变得举世闻名,是因为他在拉斯维加斯收购了一个科技大会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he buys this tech conference for I think about 880 million.
zh: 而且他买下这个科技大会花了大概 8.8 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at the same time, he has his own tech businesses and he owns a phone company and he starts growing and growing.
zh: 与此同时,他有自己的科技业务,他拥有一家手机公司,并且不断扩张、不断增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's famous to have gone to Steve Jobs and said, I'm going to take the iPhone.
zh: 他出名的一件事是去找史蒂夫·乔布斯说,我要拿下 iPhone。

speaker: Unknown
en: When the iPhone just came out, he knew it was going to be a hit and I'm going to give it to every subscriber in Japan.
zh: iPhone 刚发布时,他就知道它会大卖,并且我要把它卖给日本的每一位用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: He invents the leasing model for it and gives an iPhone.
zh: 他为此发明了租赁模式,并提供 iPhone。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then everybody signs to his service because everybody wanted the iPhone.
zh: 于是每个人都签约他的服务,因为每个人都想要 iPhone。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a lot of things.
zh: 有很多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then he gives Jack Ma $20 million that over time I think becomes $200 million.
zh: 然后他给了马云 2000 万美元,随着时间推移,我认为变成了 2 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: For Alibaba.
zh: 投给了阿里巴巴。

speaker: Unknown
en: For Alibaba, which at its peak is worth about $80 billion.
zh: 投给了阿里巴巴,这家公司在巅峰时价值约 800 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: So at the time when I meet Masa, this is 2016.
zh: 所以我见到 Masa 的时候,是 2016 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's start with the night before.
zh: 让我们从见面前一晚说起。

speaker: Unknown
en: The night before I meet Masa in New York City, I have a board meeting the day before.
zh: 我在纽约市见 Masa 的前一晚,前一天我有一个董事会会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the old board.
zh: 那是老董事会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're all sitting together.
zh: 我们都坐在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just raised at 16.
zh: 我刚以 160 亿估值完成融资。

speaker: Unknown
en: I raised maybe six months before at 16 billion valuation.
zh: 我大概在六个月前融资,估值 160 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: How big does we work?
zh: WeWork 规模有多大?

speaker: Unknown
en: It's about to do that year about 950 million in revenue.
zh: 那一年营收大概要达到 9.5 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason I know is because we were doubled in revenue every single year.
zh: 我之所以知道,是因为我们每年营收都翻倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: So WeWork, the business model was working very well and the four walls were working very well.
zh: 所以 WeWork 的商业模式运转得非常好,四面墙业务也运转得非常好。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the distinction, sorry, between the four walls and everything else?
zh: 抱歉,四面墙业务和其他业务之间的区别是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: You have a retail business.
zh: 你有一个零售业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could have your stores could be doing really well.
zh: 你的门店可能经营得非常好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your state not making money.
zh: 但你的州不赚钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And your what's not making money?
zh: 你的什么不赚钱?

speaker: Unknown
en: State.
zh: 州。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's say you're in New York City.
zh: 比如说你在纽约市。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's talk high growth for a second.
zh: 那我们谈一下高增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you're growing as fast as we're growing, you're always putting new buildings on the map.
zh: 当你以我们这样的速度增长时,你总是在地图上不断添加新的大楼。

speaker: Unknown
en: A new building has a ramp up.
zh: 一栋新大楼有一个爬坡期。

speaker: Unknown
en: Usually ramp up of a retail store or food or a restaurant could take two years, three years.
zh: 通常一家零售店或食品店或餐厅的爬坡期可能需要两年、三年。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we like to talk about ROI, return on investment, and how long does it take?
zh: 而我们喜欢谈 ROI,投资回报率,以及需要多长时间?

speaker: Unknown
en: A great time to return your investment would be 24 months, 36 months, and then can grow.
zh: 一个收回投资的好时间是 24 个月、36 个月,然后可以增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: We work at the speak was returning its money somewhere between six months to nine months.
zh: WeWork 当时(原音 speak)是在六个月到九个月之间收回成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then afterwards, it's going up to 12 months and 18 months.
zh: 而之后,则上升到了 12 个月和 18 个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you're gonna grow, we grew New York City to 130 buildings.
zh: 所以如果你要增长——我们把纽约开到了 130 栋楼。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can have 30 buildings.
zh: 比如你有 30 栋楼。

speaker: Unknown
en: If the following year you're adding 30 more buildings, those new 30 have to, per definition, lose money for at least the first six months, if not nine months.
zh: 如果第二年你再加 30 栋，那新加的 30 栋按定义至少头六个月、甚至九个月是亏钱的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you could be very profitable in these buildings, but not profitable in these, because they need time.
zh: 所以你可能在这些楼里非常赚钱，但在那些楼里不赚钱，因为它们需要时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which means New York City, the city, doesn't look as a city profitable.
zh: 这意味着纽约这个城市，作为一个整体看起来是不盈利的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or the country, if you're looking at your P&L, doesn't look as a country profitable.
zh: 或者从国家层面看损益表，作为一个国家看起来也不盈利。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is why in a high-growth business, you've got to get very specific and in the details.
zh: 这就是为什么在高增长业务里，你必须非常具体、深入细节。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you've got to really understand what's working, what's not.
zh: 你必须真正搞清楚什么在起作用、什么没起作用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even in a building, you can have one floor that's profitable because you opened it first.
zh: 甚至在一栋楼里，可能有某一层是盈利的，因为你先开了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the new floor that you opened after, not profitable yet.
zh: 而后来新开的那层还没盈利。

speaker: Unknown
en: WeWork's technology was never able to count this way.
zh: WeWork 的技术从来没能按这种方式来核算。

speaker: Unknown
en: Flow's technology, if I threw it on WeWork today, I could tell you which square foot is, I forget which building is profitable or which floor is profitable.
zh: Flow 的技术，如果我今天把它套到 WeWork 上，我能告诉你是——我忘了是哪栋楼盈利还是哪一层盈利。

speaker: Unknown
en: I could tell you which corner is, it knows everything because it's a connected system.
zh: 我能告诉你是哪个角落，它什么都知道，因为它是一个互联的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not disconnected.
zh: 它不是割裂的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Back to what we're saying.
zh: 回到我们刚才说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sitting with the board and we decide that we want to turn the business.
zh: 我和董事会坐在一起，我们决定要扭转这家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to go out and raise money, turn the business profitable and take it public.
zh: 我们要出去融资，把公司扭亏为盈，然后带它上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: How are you going to turn it profitable?
zh: 你要怎么扭亏为盈？

speaker: Unknown
en: All you have to do in a high growth business that's working to turn it profitable is stop growing.
zh: 在一个运转中的高增长业务里，想扭亏为盈，你要做的只是停止增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: You just stop adding new buildings and you give time to all the buildings to catch up.
zh: 你只要不再新增楼，给所有楼时间去追上来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, I explained that in WeWork, your problem was not demand.
zh: 记得我说过，在 WeWork，你的问题不是需求。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was supply.
zh: 是供给。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the moment you don't add more supply, the demand is greater than the supply.
zh: 所以一旦你不再增加供给，需求就大于供给。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything fills up.
zh: 一切都会填满。

speaker: Unknown
en: The moment everything fills up and you didn't add anything new, you go cashflow positive.
zh: 一旦一切填满，而你又没有新增任何东西，你就现金流转正了。

speaker: Unknown
en: As simple as that.
zh: 就这么简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we sit in that board and we decide that I'm going to go and raise, and the number was three to 400 million, stop the growth, meaning stop signing leases, maybe even move to management deals, something we'll talk about in floor in a second.
zh: 于是我们在董事会上决定，我要去融资，数字是三到四亿，停止增长，也就是说不再签租约，甚至可能转向管理协议——这个我们待会儿讲 Flow 的时候再说。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then take it public.
zh: 然后带它上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is 2016.

speaker: Unknown
en: That was the
zh: 那是——

speaker: Unknown
en: the day before.
zh: 前一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: The same time, at some point, Massa's right-hand guy, his name is Ron Fisher, sends an email, a text to one of our guys, and says, hey, Massa wants to come see Adam.
zh: 同一时间，某一天，Masa 的左膀右臂，他叫 Ron Fisher，给我们其中一个伙计发了封邮件、一条短信，说，嘿，Masa 想来见 Adam。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is at the same time that Massa is raising the Vision Fund.
zh: 这正是 Masa 在募集愿景基金的同时。

speaker: Unknown
en: For those who don't know, the Vision Fund was his $100 billion venture fund, largest venture fund ever raised.
zh: 给不知道的人说一下，愿景基金是他的一千亿美元风险投资基金，是有史以来募集的最大的风险基金。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa wants to see Adam.
zh: Masa 想见 Adam。

speaker: Unknown
en: Say, great.
zh: 我们说，好啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we schedule 90 minutes in the morning, the next morning.
zh: 于是我们约了第二天早上 90 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we do, we do the, we get ready in the morning.
zh: 然后我们就，我们做了准备，早上做准备。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa is coming.
zh: Masa 要来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone's excited.
zh: 大家都很兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, this is amazing.
zh: 我心想，这太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe that investment we just talked about yesterday will come today.
zh: 也许我们昨天刚聊的那笔投资今天就会来。

speaker: Unknown
en: His team says, just to let you know, there will be no discussions of investing.
zh: 他的团队说，先跟你打个招呼，不会有任何关于投资的讨论。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, okay, no problem.
zh: 于是，好吧，没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: As it gets closer to the morning, we keep getting text messages.
zh: 随着早上的时间越来越近，我们不断收到短信。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's not going to have 90 minutes.
zh: 他不会有 90 分钟了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's going to have 75 minutes.
zh: 他只有 75 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's going to have 60 minutes.
zh: 他只有 60 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's going to have half an hour.
zh: 他只有半小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, okay, whatever it is, sounds great.
zh: 我心想，行，多久都行，听起来很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: The same time President Trump wins for the first time, this is the end of December, and Masa had a meeting with him.
zh: 同一时间，特朗普总统第一次赢得大选，这是十二月底，Masa 和他见了一面。

speaker: Unknown
en: They wanted to talk about the future of America.
zh: 他们想谈谈美国的未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, I'm so sorry, I have a meeting with Trump, President Trump, and I only have 12 minutes.
zh: 他说，非常抱歉，我要和特朗普、特朗普总统开会，我只有 12 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, we all find ourselves in situations like this when, oh my God, I had all this plan and I was going to do this tour and I was going to show these numbers.
zh: 又来了，我们都会遇到这种情况，天哪，我做好了所有计划，本来要做这场参观，本来要展示这些数字，

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to do all these things and suddenly it all changes.
zh: 我要做所有这些事情，突然一切全变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I take a deep breath.
zh: 我深吸一口气。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's make it the best 12 minutes we can.
zh: 咱们把这点时间尽量变成最好的 12 分钟吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I can't help myself.
zh: 但我忍不住。

speaker: Unknown
en: I go, tell me something, Masa.
zh: 我说，告诉我一件事，Masa。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're meeting President, future President Trump, do you have Jared Kushner introducing you to him first?
zh: 如果你要见总统、未来的总统特朗普，是不是得先有 Jared Kushner 介绍你们认识？

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, Adam, it's so funny you're saying that.
zh: 他说，Adam，真巧你这么问。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody told me that it's better if Jared introduces me.
zh: 所有人都告诉我，如果由 Jared 介绍会更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know him.
zh: 我不认识他。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've been trying to get in touch.
zh: 我们一直在试着联系上。

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, give me a second.
zh: 我说，等我一秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm very lucky to count Jared as one of my close friends.
zh: 我非常幸运，能把 Jared 算作我的挚友之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jared's married to Ivanka Trump.
zh: Jared 娶了 Ivanka Trump。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jared's married to Ivanka Trump, and he's the advisor, I think, to the president.
zh: Jared 娶了 Ivanka Trump，我想他是总统的顾问。

speaker: Unknown
en: But right now, he's helping to peace both in the Middle East and in Europe.
zh: 但现在，他在帮助促成中东和欧洲的和平。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I text Jared, and I was like, Masa is here, ta-ta-ta-ta-ta.
zh: 所以我给 Jared 发短信，我说，Masa 在这儿，等等等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: We spend five minutes on that.
zh: 我们在这上面花了五分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jared says, no problem.
zh: Jared 说，没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Send him.
zh: 让他来吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I will introduce him to the future president.
zh: 我会把他介绍给未来的总统。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we have seven minutes left.
zh: 现在我们还剩七分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say, Masa, we only have seven minutes.
zh: 我说，Masa，我们只有七分钟了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're only going to stay downstairs.
zh: 我们只去楼下吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this is WeWork.
zh: 但这里是 WeWork。

speaker: Unknown
en: He looks at me, goes like this.
zh: 他看着我，做了这样一个动作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Smells there.
zh: 在那儿闻了闻。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, you know what this smells like?
zh: 他说，你知道这闻起来像什么吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, oh no, what is he going to say?
zh: 我心想，哦不，他要说什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: They were serving waffles.
zh: 他们当时在供应华夫饼。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is he going to say it smells like waffles?
zh: 他是不是要说这闻起来像华夫饼？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, what is he going to say?
zh: 就像，他要说什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, smells like dreams.
zh: 他说，闻起来像梦想。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a factory.
zh: 这是一个工厂。

speaker: Unknown
en: Work is not an office space.
zh: 工作不是一个办公空间。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a factory of dreams.
zh: 他接过了那个「梦想家」，然后比梦想家还高一步。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, he's speaking your language.
zh: 我心想，他在说你们的语言。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh no, not my language.
zh: 哦不，不是我的语言。

speaker: Unknown
en: One step above my language.
zh: 比我的语言还高一个层级。

speaker: Unknown
en: He took the dreamer and went one step above the dreamer.
zh: 他超越了那个 dreamer,比 dreamer 更进一步。

speaker: Unknown
en: He outdid the...
zh: 他超越了……

speaker: Unknown
en: He Adam'd Adam.
zh: 他把 Adam 给「Adam」了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He killed it.
zh: 他太厉害了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, oh yeah, I have this smell of dreams.
zh: 我就想，哦对，我有这种梦想的味道。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one's ever defined a business better than that.
zh: 从没有人比这更好地定义过一门生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he goes, look Adam, we don't have time.
zh: 然后他说，听着 Adam，我们没时间了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm driving up there to 50th Street, wherever it was.
zh: 我开车去那里，去50街，不管是在哪儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you want to come with me to the car?
zh: 你想跟我一起去车上吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll talk in the car.
zh: 我们在车里聊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did he not go around the building and... Couldn't have time.
zh: 他没有绕着大楼转一圈然后……没时间了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Seven minutes.
zh: 七分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were only downstairs in the lobby.
zh: 我们只在楼下的大厅里。

speaker: Unknown
en: The entrance, but...
zh: 在入口那里，但是……

speaker: Unknown
en: If you had the opportunity in 2017, 2016 to walk into RHQ, the energy was electric.
zh: 如果你有机会在2017年、2016年走进RHQ，那里的能量是带电的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could not walk in there and not feel, I never felt a factory of dreams, but I felt community and people coming together.
zh: 你不可能走进去而感觉不到，我从未感觉那是一座梦工厂，但我感觉到了社区，感觉到了人们聚在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: It felt like people are doing their life's work.
zh: 感觉就像人们在做自己一生的事业。

speaker: Unknown
en: It didn't feel like a work environment.
zh: 那不像一个工作环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: It felt like people are really connected.
zh: 感觉就像人们真正彼此连接着。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you make a connected environment, then it really takes things to the next level and everybody wants to be there.
zh: 当你营造出一个彼此连接的环境时，事情就会真正迈上一个新的台阶，每个人都想待在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's what it was.
zh: 所以那就是它当初的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not what it is today, but that's what it was.
zh: 现在已经不是这样了，但当初就是那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: So he says, come with me to the car.
zh: 所以他说，跟我一起到车上来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, no problem.
zh: 我说，没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: I get into the car and I remember the back of my hand.
zh: 我上了车，我记得我的手背。

speaker: Unknown
en: They said, no investing.
zh: 他们说，不许谈投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: His team said, don't talk about raising money.
zh: 他的团队说，别提融资的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, so I start talking a bit while we work.
zh: 他说，好，那我们在车上的时候我就开始聊一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like, Adam, what's the number?
zh: 他说，Adam，数字是多少？

speaker: Unknown
en: So what do you mean?
zh: 我说，你是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because what's your valuation and how much money you're raising?
zh: 因为你的估值是多少，你要融多少钱？

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, I'm here to do business.
zh: 他说，我是来做生意的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, your team said like, ah.
zh: 我说，你的团队说了……他哎呀一声。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am the boss.
zh: 我是老板。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've done this many times myself.
zh: 这种事我自己做过很多次了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm the boss.
zh: 我是老板。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk about it.
zh: 我们来谈谈吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, well, listen, we have our last valuation was 16 billion.
zh: 我说，好吧，听着，我们上一轮估值是160亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have, we have, we just launched China.
zh: 我们有，我们有，我们刚刚在中国上线。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a two billion dollar company.
zh: 那是一家20亿美元规模的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have Latin America and we're in Europe.
zh: 我们有拉丁美洲，我们在欧洲。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a global company and then we have a China entity.
zh: 我们是一家全球性的公司，另外我们还有一个中国实体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Goes great.
zh: 他说，很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: How much are you raising?
zh: 你要融多少钱？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, three to 400 million.
zh: 我说，三到四亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Three to 400 million.
zh: 三到四亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's.
zh: 那。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not going to work.
zh: 那可不行。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't you want to build a global business?
zh: 难道你不想建一家全球性的生意吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, of course.
zh: 我说，当然想。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would love to build a global business.
zh: 我很想建一家全球性的生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, don't you have a business in China?
zh: 他说，难道你不是在中国有生意吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, of course.
zh: 我说，当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, what about Japan?
zh: 他说，那日本呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, I don't have a business in Japan yet.
zh: 我说，我在日本还没有生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, I think it's going to work very well in Japan.
zh: 他说，我觉得它在日本会做得非常好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, I'm sure it's going to work well in Japan.
zh: 我说，我确信它在日本会做得很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's working everywhere.
zh: 它到处都行得通。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I don't have the team.
zh: 但我没有团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, what about Southeast Asia?
zh: 他说，东南亚怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, sounds amazing, but I've never been there.
zh: 我说，听起来很棒，但我从没去过那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, well, I think it's going to work there.
zh: 他说，嗯，我觉得它在那里会行得通。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, again, I'm sure it's going to work there.
zh: 我说，再说一次，我确定它在那里会行得通。

speaker: Unknown
en: And before you know it, he says, I think we should do about $3 billion.
zh: 然后不知不觉间，他说，我觉得我们应该投大约 30 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was a big number.
zh: 那是个很大的数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, I was the night before the board, 300 to 400 million.
zh: 记得吗，那是董事会的前一晚，数字还是 3 亿到 4 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Stake lesson number one.
zh: Stake(股权)教训第一课。

speaker: Unknown
en: And again, I don't blame Masa for any of this.
zh: 再说一次，我不会为此怪 Masa(孙正义)。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every decision I made was my decision.
zh: 我做的每一个决定都是我自己的决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's an investor.
zh: 他是个投资人。

speaker: Unknown
en: He saw a great business and he wanted to go big.
zh: 他看到了一门好生意，想做大。

speaker: Unknown
en: I respect that.
zh: 我尊重这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've done it myself.
zh: 我自己也这么干过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not those numbers, but I've done it myself.
zh: 不是那些数字的规模，但我自己也这么干过。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you decide you have a mission or a vision and you're going to go raise out 300 million, and the next day someone offers you 3 billion, before you say yes, take a deep breath and ask yourself, again, that question of why?
zh: 如果你认定自己有一个使命或愿景，打算去融 3 亿，然后第二天有人给你 30 亿，在你说好之前，深吸一口气，再次问问自己那个问题：为什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And what is my intention?
zh: 我的意图是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And what is that going to do to the business?
zh: 这笔钱会对这门生意产生什么影响？

speaker: Unknown
en: And am I ready to take that much?
zh: 我准备好拿这么多钱了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So it says 3 billion, we then keep talking about all the different needs and the different stuff.
zh: 于是说到 30 亿，我们接着聊了各种不同的需求和各种不同的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: It ends up after this is now we met for 12 minutes and the ride is 16 minutes.
zh: 最后的结果是，那次我们见面只聊了 12 分钟，车程是 16 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: So yeah, total 28 to 36 minutes, the whole thing.
zh: 所以是的，前后总共 28 到 36 分钟，整个过程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And...
zh: 然后……

speaker: Unknown
en: We agree on the, he says 4 billion, 4.2 to be exact.
zh: 我们达成了一致，他说 40 亿，准确说是 42 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: 4.2 billion what?
zh: 42 亿什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Dollars.
zh: 美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: That he wants to invest.
zh: 他想投资的金额。

speaker: Unknown
en: In, we work TopCo, we work China, we work Japan, and we work Southeast Asia.
zh: 投资于 WeWork TopCo、WeWork 中国、WeWork 日本，以及 WeWork 东南亚。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, we were a cash machine.
zh: 记得吗，我们当时是一台现金机器。

speaker: Unknown
en: You put cash into us, and we, just to, I'll go back to it in a second, but we were doing 980 million that year.
zh: 你把钱投进来，我们……我待会儿再说回这个，但我们那年做到了 9.8 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: We hit our numbers.
zh: 我们达成了目标数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: We forecasted we're going to do 1.8 billion next year.
zh: 我们预测明年会做到 18 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: We did our 1.8 billion.
zh: 我们做到了那个 18 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wow.
zh: 哇。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was working so well, the model, all you needed was cash to build it.
zh: 那个模型运转得非常好，你需要的只是现金去把它建起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: You needed to build these spaces and you needed to do, if you're going to grow that big, he had big aspirations and I had big aspirations.
zh: 你需要建这些空间，你需要去做，如果你要长到那么大，他有很大的抱负，我也有很大的抱负。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you tell him that?
zh: 你跟他讲过这个吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you tell him that it was a cash machine?
zh: 你跟他讲过它是一台现金机器吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, you didn't need to.
zh: 不，不需要讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you tell him that if you put cash in, you get cash out?
zh: 你跟他讲过投现金进来就能拿现金出去吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't need to.
zh: 我不需要讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa understands business better than most people in the world.
zh: Masa(孙正义)对生意的理解比世界上大多数人都深。

speaker: Unknown
en: But again, it was obvious because if you looked at the history of WeWork, every single time you put money into it, it grew.
zh: 但再说一次，这很明显，因为如果你看 WeWork 的历史，每一次你把钱投进去，它就增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: The mistake was we were signing leases.
zh: 错误在于我们签的是租约。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were taking long-term commitments against short-term commitments.
zh: 我们在拿长期承诺去对抗短期承诺。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should have done something else, and we'll talk about it in a second, what we should have done, and it's what we're doing in flow.
zh: 我们本应该做点别的事，我们待会儿会讲到本应该做什么，也就是我们现在在 flow 里做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this question was, there's people, because a lot of people didn't understand the money raised.
zh: 但这个问题在于，有人……因为很多人不理解那笔融资。

speaker: Unknown
en: The money raised was to build tremendous businesses all over the planet.
zh: 那笔融资是为了在全世界建起巨大的生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: And those businesses, the moment you stopped growing them, turned profitable.
zh: 而那些业务,一旦你停止扩张它们,就转为盈利了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, WeWork's profitable.
zh: 今天,WeWork 是盈利的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those businesses, all you had to do was stop growing.
zh: 那些业务,你只需要停止扩张就行。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were at a high growth stage.
zh: 我们当时处于高速增长阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what high growth entrepreneurs do.
zh: 高速增长期的创业者就是这么做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what the market wanted at the time.
zh: 那也是当时市场想要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what everybody knew we were doing.
zh: 而且每个人都知道我们在做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was not a secret what we were doing.
zh: 我们在做什么并不是秘密。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was growing exponentially.
zh: 而且它正在指数级增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we ended up agreeing on 4.2 billion.
zh: 所以我们最终就 42 亿达成了一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: He takes an iPad.
zh: 他拿出一个 iPad。

speaker: Unknown
en: He writes it all down.
zh: 他把所有这些都写了下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is all in that same car ride.
zh: 这一切都发生在同一趟车程里。

speaker: Unknown
en: He writes it all down.
zh: 他把所有这些都写了下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: He signs his name and he hands me the pen to sign mine.
zh: 他签上自己的名字,然后把笔递给我让我签名。

speaker: Unknown
en: I look at it.
zh: 我看了看。

speaker: Unknown
en: I sign.
zh: 我签了字。

speaker: Unknown
en: He walks out of the car, says, thank you very much and goes to his meeting.
zh: 他走下车,说了声"非常感谢",就去参加他的会议了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is now about 54th Street.
zh: 这时候大概是在 54 街。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our HQ is on 18th Street.
zh: 我们的总部在 18 街。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm just standing there.
zh: 我只是站在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can't believe what just happened.
zh: 我不敢相信刚刚发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was not what I planned.
zh: 这不是我计划好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I start walking.
zh: 然后我开始走路。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, I'm going to walk downtown.
zh: 我心想,我要走着去市中心。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to take a second.
zh: 我要缓一缓。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every step I take, because until this point, this is 2016, we were five years of mission driven.
zh: 而我走的每一步,因为到那时为止——那是 2016 年——我们已经使命驱动了五年。

speaker: Unknown
en: You asked me about the fundamentals.
zh: 你问过我基本面的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had all the right fundamentals in WeWork because we had the right culture.
zh: WeWork 的基本面都是对的,因为我们有正确的文化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you have the right culture, you can deal with any challenge.
zh: 而当你有正确的文化时,你可以应对任何挑战。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were mission driven.
zh: 我们是使命驱动的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We could break through any wall.
zh: 我们可以突破任何一堵墙。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were teamwork.
zh: 我们是团队协作。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were related.
zh: 我们彼此关联。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were together.
zh: 我们在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were friends.
zh: 我们是朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were one team.
zh: 我们是一个团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm starting to walk down from 54th Street to 18th Street.
zh: 然后我开始从 54 街往 18 街走。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every step I take, suddenly, the ego starts coming up.
zh: 而我走的每一步,突然,自我开始膨胀起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, 20 billion valuation.
zh: 哦,200 亿的估值。

speaker: Unknown
en: Billion valuation in Japan on top of that, billion and a half valuation in Southeast Asia on top of that, $5 billion valuation in China on top of that.
zh: 在此之上,日本的估值 10 亿,在此之上,东南亚的估值 15 亿,在此之上,中国的估值 50 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a billion of that 4.2 was going to everybody, including to myself.
zh: 所以那 42 亿中的 10 亿会分给每一个人,包括我自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I owned about proportionately about 25% of the company at the time.
zh: 而我当时按比例拥有公司大约 25% 的股份。

speaker: Unknown
en: So big numbers, numbers.
zh: 所以是大数字,数字啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've never seen numbers.
zh: 我从没见过这样的数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: Miguel was getting a lot.
zh: Miguel 拿到了很多。

speaker: Unknown
en: All our employees, the investors, many times more than they ever invested from that billion.
zh: 我们所有的员工、投资人,从那 10 亿中拿到的比他们当初投资的多了很多倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every step that I'm taking, the ego comes up.
zh: 而我走的每一步,自我都在膨胀。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, I feel so strong.
zh: 哦,我感觉自己如此强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel so big.
zh: 我感觉自己好膨胀。

speaker: Unknown
en: You start doing your own math, 20 billion, 25%.
zh: 你开始自己算数，200 亿，25%。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's, that's 5 billion.
zh: 那是多少，那是 50 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then there's all the other ones.
zh: 然后还有其他那些。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's my net worth?
zh: 我的净资产是多少？

speaker: Unknown
en: And before you know it,
zh: 不知不觉间，

speaker: Unknown
en: The guy that sat in the car was a mission-driven entrepreneur who really believed in creating a world where people make a life and not just a living.
zh: 那个坐在车里的家伙，是一个使命驱动的企业家，真心相信要创造一个人们过出人生、而不只是谋生的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every step that I take, it goes higher and higher.
zh: 我走的每一步，都越来越高涨。

speaker: Unknown
en: And by the time I walk into HQ, 18th Street, I forgot what we were all about.
zh: 等我走进总部，18 街的时候，我已经忘了我们到底是干什么的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's why ego is on the one hand very good and on the other very dangerous.
zh: 这就是为什么自我一方面非常好，另一方面又非常危险。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ego and desire are the same word.
zh: 自我和欲望是同一个词。

speaker: Unknown
en: Big ego just means big desire.
zh: 大自我只意味着大欲望。

speaker: Unknown
en: Having huge desire is important to build huge things.
zh: 而在一个高增长的业务里，你每天要做 100 个决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you have to manage it and control it.
zh: 但你必须管理它、控制它。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I walked in, I got confused.
zh: 当我走进去的时候，我糊涂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It suddenly became about the money.
zh: 它突然变成了关于钱的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: All the stuff that Rebecca told me, all the stuff when we met, all the years of spiritual practice, everything, to the garbage.
zh: Rebecca 告诉我的一切，我们见面时的一切，那么多年的灵性修行，一切，都扔进了垃圾堆。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what happens when the ego gets the best of you?
zh: 那么当自我战胜了你，会发生什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: You become blinded.
zh: 你会变得盲目。

speaker: Unknown
en: What does that mean?
zh: 这是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: You make mistakes and bad decisions.
zh: 你会犯错、做出糟糕的决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in a high growth business, you need to make 100 decisions a day.
zh: 而在一个高增长的业务里,你每天需要做 100 个决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as we said before, at least 98 of them need to be correct.
zh: 而正如我们之前说的，其中至少 98 个必须是正确的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Suddenly you're blinded and suddenly only 95 of them are correct or 90.
zh: 突然你变得盲目，突然只有 95 个是正确的，或者 90 个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those mistakes, because you're growing so fast, the mistakes grow very fast also.
zh: 那些错误，因为你增长得那么快，错误也增长得非常快。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other thing, we were a company led from the top.
zh: 另一件事，我们是一家自上而下领导的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: All great companies are led from the top.
zh: 所有伟大的公司都是自上而下领导的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The one that I lost it, everybody lost it.
zh: 我失去它的那一刻，每个人都失去了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it just spread.
zh: 然后它就蔓延开了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the moment starts, that's the beginning of the end.
zh: 而那一刻一开始，那就是终结的开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: And look, it took three years after that for everything to unfold.
zh: 你看，那之后花了三年时间一切才全部展开。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it was that moment that was the moment that went.
zh: 但就是那个时刻，就是那个走掉的瞬间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there anything that could have been said or done to have made you when Masa offered you that $4 billion in that cab?
zh: 当 Masa 在那辆出租车里给你那 40 亿美元的时候，有没有什么可以说或可以做的话，能让你改变？

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you ready for this?
zh: 你准备好听了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Sure.
zh: 当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: I used to be closer.
zh: 我以前和他更亲近。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't speak as much anymore today.
zh: 我们今天已经不那么常说话了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I used to be much closer to Mark Benioff, the founder of Salesforce.
zh: 我以前和 Salesforce 的创始人 Mark Benioff 要亲近得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: He heard about Masa's offer and he called me and said, Adam, I only know you for a little bit and I know you're not going to listen to my advice.
zh: 他听说了 Masa 的报价，他打电话给我说，Adam，我认识你时间不长，我知道你不会听我的建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: but I want you to fly to Japan and say no to Masa.
zh: 但我要你飞去日本，对 Masa 说不。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want you to take your company public.
zh: 我要你把你的公司上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was your last valuation?
zh: 你们上一次估值是多少？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said 16.
zh: 我说 160 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, great.
zh: 他说，好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want you to take your company public for 5 billion.
zh: 我要你以 50 亿把你的公司上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want you to sell 20% of it a billion.
zh: 我要你卖掉 20%，就是 10 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I want you to learn how to be public CEO.
zh: 我要你学会怎么做上市的 CEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: I promise you two things.
zh: 我向你保证两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: One, because your last valuation was 16 at 5, everybody's going to think this is a great deal.
zh: 第一，因为你上一次估值是 160 亿，现在 50 亿，所有人都会觉得这是个划算的买卖。

speaker: Unknown
en: People are going to rush to invest.
zh: 人们会争相来投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: including myself.
zh: 包括我自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone's going to rush to invest.
zh: 所有人都会抢着来投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: You'll learn because it's very different to be public CEO and a private CEO.
zh: 你会学到东西的,因为上市公司的 CEO 和私营公司的 CEO 是非常不同的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to learn about profitability.
zh: 你会学到关于盈利能力的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to learn all these things because I think you're a very fast student.
zh: 你会学到所有这些东西,因为我觉得你是个学得非常快的学生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I guarantee you, before you know it, your valuation will be much larger.
zh: 而且我向你保证,不知不觉之间,你的估值会大得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, but I know you're not going to listen to me.
zh: 然后他说,但我知道你不会听我的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I didn't.
zh: 而我确实没听。

speaker: Unknown
en: Was there a world that I could have said no
zh: 有没有一种可能我是可以说不的

speaker: Unknown
en: Not the kind of person that I was then and not with the tools I have.
zh: 那时候的我不是那种人,而且也没有我现在拥有的这些工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why didn't you listen to him?
zh: 你为什么没听他的?

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't know each other for long enough.
zh: 我们当时认识的时间还不够长。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it takes a lot of trust to listen to when someone gives you a counter advice.
zh: 我觉得当有人给你反向建议时,听取它需要很大的信任。

speaker: Unknown
en: And by the way, there was another person also who said no, but we'll put that aside for a second.
zh: 顺便说一下,当时还有另一个人也说不要,但我们先把这个放一边。

speaker: Unknown
en: But here's what I think is more important about it.
zh: 但我认为在这件事上更重要的东西是这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's say I said no.
zh: 假设我说了不。

speaker: Unknown
en: And let's say WeWork would still be around.
zh: 再假设 WeWork 还存在着。

speaker: Unknown
en: WeWork would be a $100 billion company today.
zh: WeWork 今天会是一家价值一千亿美元的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Corona would have happened.
zh: 新冠还是会发生的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We would have renegotiated all of our leases.
zh: 我们会重新谈判我们所有的租约。

speaker: Unknown
en: That of leases would become management deals.
zh: 那些租约会变成管理协议。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we would have led the return to office.
zh: 而且我们会引领重返办公室的潮流。

speaker: Unknown
en: We would have led that concept because obviously people work.
zh: 我们会成为那个理念的引领者,因为显然人们工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know we spoke about it much better face-to-face than remote work.
zh: 我知道我们聊过,面对面工作比远程工作好得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we would have been the leaders of the movement of return to office.
zh: 而我们会成为重返办公室运动的引领者。

speaker: Unknown
en: And WeWork was a great company.
zh: 而且 WeWork 本来是一家很棒的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even it would have launched WeLive.
zh: 甚至它还会推出 WeLive。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a version of Floa.
zh: 也就是 Floa 的一个版本。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I, Adam, wouldn't have learned all those lessons.
zh: 但我,Adam,就不会学到所有那些教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wouldn't be, I am so much happier today.
zh: 我就不会是……我今天幸福得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even as we're speaking, I'm not the same as you're like, everything you're talking to about makes me feel full.
zh: 即便在我们现在交谈的时候,我也不是……你就像,你谈到的每一件事都让我感到充实。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even the challenging parts.
zh: 连那些充满挑战的部分也是。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am so happy that they happened because they made me exactly who I'm meant to be.
zh: 我非常庆幸它们发生了,因为它们造就了今天的我,正是我命中注定要成为的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Falling is not bad.
zh: 跌倒并不是坏事。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the thing that you and I are actually talking about.
zh: 这其实正是你和我一直在谈论的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Falling is probably the most important part of life.
zh: 跌倒可能是人生中最重要的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And most of us learn a lot more from falling than we do from succeeding.
zh: 我们大多数人从跌倒中学到的东西,比从成功中学到的多得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing that's bad is not when you fall.
zh: 糟糕的不是你跌倒的那一刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's how you get up.
zh: 而是你如何站起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just fell and you're, oh no, everybody saw me fall.
zh: 如果你只是跌倒了,然后想着,哦不,所有人都看到我跌倒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not going to hide under the covers for four years until everybody forgets whatever it is that happened.
zh: 我要躲在被子底下躲上四年,直到所有人都忘记发生过的那件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what's horrible.
zh: 那才是真正可怕的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That leads to the tragedy.
zh: 那才会导致悲剧。

speaker: Unknown
en: That leads to the trauma.
zh: 那才会导致创伤。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you fell, you look around, you're like, wow, everybody saw.
zh: 如果你跌倒了,你环顾四周,然后想着,哇,所有人都看到了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You clean up, you get up and you say, let's do it again.
zh: 你收拾干净,站起来,然后说,我们再来一次。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have that in you, nothing will stop you and it might take 10 times and 20 times and 50 times.
zh: 如果你骨子里有这个,没有什么能阻挡你,哪怕要跌十次、二十次、五十次。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you fall enough times, then you might avoid falling.
zh: 但如果你跌倒的次数够多,你反而可能学会避免跌倒。

speaker: Unknown
en: there should be a button just down below here.
zh: 这下面应该有一个按钮。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if it says subscribe, you're already subscribed.
zh: 如果它显示的是"订阅",那说明你已经订阅了。

speaker: Unknown
en: If it says subscriber, that means you're not yet.
zh: 如果它显示已订阅，那就说明你还没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you're not subscribed, please could you do us a favour and hit that button.
zh: 如果你还没订阅，请帮我们一个忙，点一下那个按钮。

speaker: Unknown
en: It helps the show more than you know.
zh: 这对节目的帮助超乎你的想象。

speaker: Unknown
en: And according to the algorithm, you're someone that watches our show, but you haven't yet hit that button.
zh: 而且根据算法，你是会看我们节目的人，但你还没点那个按钮。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you so much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm thinking also about a founder that's 21 years old.
zh: 我还在想一个 21 岁的创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They've got a startup or an idea that they want to start.
zh: 他们有一个想要开始的创业项目或想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like when I was 21 years old, my mum tells me, well, 18, if you do this, I won't speak to you again.
zh: 就像我 21 岁的时候，我妈妈告诉我，好吧，是 18 岁，如果你做这个，我就再也不跟你说话了。

speaker: Unknown
en: She was warning me against business because she had struggled in business herself.
zh: 她警告我不要经商，因为她自己曾在生意上吃过苦头。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's a proxy of love, I guess.
zh: 所以我想，那是一种爱的代理论吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you've got other people here telling you that it's going to be amazing and you're going to make millions.
zh: 然后这里还有其他人告诉你，一切会很棒，你会赚到几百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you're in that situation and you've got noise, how do you find the signal?
zh: 当你身处那种充满噪音的境地时，你如何找到信号？

speaker: Unknown
en: Two ways.
zh: 两种方法。

speaker: Unknown
en: One, two.
zh: 一，二。

speaker: Unknown
en: they have to go back to the mission.
zh: 他们必须回到使命。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if one had a mission, and then someone offers them something, and it's off mission, and you're like, oh, I'm going to do it anyway because it's good money, but it's off mission, that already is a warning sign.
zh: 所以如果一个人有一个使命，然后有人给他们提供某样东西，而它偏离使命，然后你想，哦，我还是要做，因为钱很多，但它偏离使命，这本身就已经是一个警示信号。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think the other one, which is something that I have more today than I used to back then, one needs a practice.
zh: 但我认为另一个，是我今天比以前拥有更多的东西，一个人需要一种修行/练习。

speaker: Unknown
en: Part of the way to try on the noise is with a practice.
zh: 尝试对抗噪音的方法之一，就是通过一种修行/练习。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been enjoying meditating lately in the past year, and I've been getting better and better at it.
zh: 过去一年我一直很享受冥想，而且我做得越来越好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And meditating is something that takes time.
zh: 冥想是一件需要时间的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: meditating helps drown the noise.
zh: 冥想有助于淹没噪音。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the thoughts that I do get while I meditate tend to be very healthy thoughts that are headed in a good direction.
zh: 而且我在冥想时产生的想法，往往是朝好的方向走的非常健康的想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's many things.
zh: 有很多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do the hyperbaric chamber.
zh: 我做高压氧舱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Steve Jobs talked about meditation and his sort of spiritual practices, and it's something that I actually, in the last year, I started really looking into.
zh: Steve Jobs 谈过冥想和他那类精神修行，而这正是我在过去一年里真正开始深入研究的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I say looking into, I mean, I started looking into what he did and why he did it.
zh: 我说深入研究，意思是我开始研究他做了什么、为什么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because he's someone that I look at and go, it was like he was able to see around the corner.
zh: 因为看着他，我会想，他好像能看到拐角之外的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for a guy running a big company, how was he able to make these really unpopular calls today that proved out to be true tomorrow?
zh: 作为一个经营大公司的人，他怎么能做出那些当时非常不受欢迎、第二天却被证明正确的决定？

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, one of the conclusions I arrived at is that he spent just as much time in the trenches as he did in the clouds.
zh: 而且，你知道，我得出的结论之一是，他在 trenches（ trenches/战壕）里花的时间和在云端里花的时间一样多。

speaker: Unknown
en: I.e.
zh: 也就是说，

speaker: Unknown
en: he stood away from the picture enough so he could see the full picture.
zh: 他站得离画面足够远，所以他能看到完整的画面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's something that I thought, oh, gosh, that kind of correlates to what you were saying earlier about your redefinition of hard work, not just being in the office and being there, you know, 24-7, but actually when you're on the surfboard, you're doing hard work because you're giving yourself time to see the full picture.
zh: 而这一点让我想到，哦，天哪，这和你之前说的关于你对努力工作的重新定义很相关，不仅仅是待在办公室、全天候待在那里，而是当你在冲浪板上的时候，你也在做艰苦的工作，因为你给了自己时间去看到完整的画面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you're honest with yourself about your weaknesses, like I spoke about my speech, it can elevate things, but it could also break things.
zh: 而当你对自己的弱点诚实时，就像我谈到我的演讲，它可以提升事物，但也可能破坏事物。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've seen that happen before.
zh: 我们以前见过这种情况发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: So hard work is also personal growth is very hard work.
zh: 所以艰苦的工作也包括个人成长，个人成长是非常艰苦的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And most people don't have the courage to even look in honestly, let alone change.
zh: 而且大多数人连诚实面对自己、往里看一眼的勇气都没有，更别说改变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the exact mechanism that you think would result in me being more successful at 40, in business let's say, if I did exactly what you said and focused on personal growth?
zh: 你认为的确切机制是什么，会导致我到 40 岁时更成功，比如说在商业上，如果我完全照你说的做，专注于个人成长？

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to have to start by redefining, the moment you said in business, I'm going to have to push back on it.
zh: 我得从重新定义开始，你一说出「在商业上」，我就要反驳它了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are not going to measure your success just in business.
zh: 我们不会只用商业来衡量你的成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to measure your success in life, in relationship, in friendships, in effect on the world, and in business.
zh: 我们会从生活、人际关系、友谊、对世界的影响，以及商业上来衡量你的成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you know why I'm asking this question?
zh: 你知道我为什么问这个问题吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because there will be some people that are listening right now, and they have heard, you know, founders come on, and people say, you need to just take a moment, meditate, do these things, focus on personal growth.
zh: 因为现在会有一些正在收听的人，他们已经听过，你知道，创始人上节目，人们说，你只需要抽出一点时间，冥想，做这些事情，专注于个人成长。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for whatever reason, because of their trauma, because of how they are raised, the lens that they will receive that message through, or the thing that will be the carrot,
zh: 而出于某种原因，因为他们的创伤，因为他们成长的方式，他们接收这条信息所透过的那副镜片，或者说那根胡萝卜，

speaker: Unknown
en: will be a promise that it will make them better at the thing they currently care about.
zh: 将是一个承诺，承诺这会让他们更擅长他们当前在乎的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, we might be tricking them a little bit because we're going to get them to do the work and they'll realize that other things matter.
zh: 现在，我们可能是在稍微骗他们一下，因为我们会让他们去做那些功课，然后他们会意识到其他事情也很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: But just for those people that have that lens.
zh: 但只是为了那些带着那副镜片的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to say something, and I hope people have said it here before, but I'm not sure they did.
zh: 我们要说一些话，我希望以前有人在这里说过，但我不确定他们说了没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: But tell me if people said it.
zh: 但如果有人说过，请告诉我。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to, all these founders that are listening, falling is not just okay, it's the best thing that ever happened to you.
zh: 我们要——所有正在收听的这些创始人——跌倒不仅仅是没关系，它是发生在你身上最好的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: If these founders can all redefine success, think about if in school, instead of learning about all the successes.
zh: 如果这些创始人都能重新定义成功，想想看，如果在学校里，我们不是学习所有那些成功案例，

speaker: Unknown
en: I spoke about Steve Jobs and he's a real hero of mine.
zh: 我讲到 Steve Jobs,他是我真正的英雄。

speaker: Unknown
en: But would I have wanted his life?
zh: 但我会想要他那样的人生吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: How old was he when he passed away?
zh: 他去世时多大年纪？

speaker: Unknown
en: How was the relationship with everybody around?
zh: 他和周围所有人的关系怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: How did he affect people?
zh: 他如何影响别人？

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I don't know.
zh: 现在，我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wasn't a friend.
zh: 我不是他的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know him.
zh: 我不认识他。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I am not judging or measuring.
zh: 我不是在评判或衡量。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm just telling you, we cannot measure a person just through their business achievements.
zh: 我只是告诉你，我们不能仅凭商业成就来衡量一个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We must look at people holistically.
zh: 我们必须整体地看待人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm telling all these young founders, forget, take time to meditate.
zh: 所以我告诉所有这些年轻创始人，忘了别的，花时间冥想。

speaker: Unknown
en: You asked how I do it.
zh: 你问我是怎么做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, how we quiet the noise.
zh: 我说，我们如何让噪音安静下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I answered meditation.
zh: 我回答是冥想。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that is not my first advice to them.
zh: 但那不是我对他们的第一条建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: My first advice to all of us, by the way, you talk a lot about 21 year olds with AI coming and everybody's about to be a founder.
zh: 我对我们所有人的第一条建议——顺便说一句，你经常谈到21岁的年轻人，随着AI的到来，每个人都要成为创始人的话题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody can start a business.
zh: 每个人都可以创业。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's true for everyone.
zh: 这对每个人都成立。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's true for 12 year olds and it's true for 60 year olds.
zh: 对12岁的孩子成立，对60岁的人也成立。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is for everyone.
zh: 这是面向所有人的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Have the courage to actually look inside and say, where can I become a better version of myself?
zh: 要有勇气真正地向内看，说：我哪里可以成为更好的自己？

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't work on three things, work on one thing.
zh: 不要同时改三件事，只改一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And choose that thing and work on it.
zh: 选定那件事，然后在它上面下功夫。

speaker: Unknown
en: And by the way, if you do, when you fix it, how are you going to know that it's better?
zh: 顺便说一句，如果你这么做了，当你改好它时，你怎么知道它变好了？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because you're going to see the next thing you need to work on.
zh: 因为你会看到下一个需要改进的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is like an onion.
zh: 这就像一个洋葱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every time you peel it, you will see another layer and another layer and another layer.
zh: 每次你剥开一层，你会看到另一层，再另一层，又另一层。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the advice I'm actually giving them.
zh: 这才是我真正给他们的建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm promising them.
zh: 而且我在向他们承诺，

speaker: Unknown
en: that if they look deep enough, what they're going to find is their calling.
zh: 如果他们看得足够深，他们会找到的是他们的使命召唤。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when they find their calling, when you match that calling with that energy of wanting to be a founder, that's when everything works.
zh: 而当他们找到自己的使命召唤，当这份召唤与想成为创始人的那股能量相匹配时，一切才会运转起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: As we are able as human beings to do that, find our true journey, find our flow, the world is open for us.
zh: 当我们作为人类能够做到这一点，找到自己真正的旅程，找到自己的心流，世界就向我们敞开。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's zoom back into the story.
zh: 那么，让我们把镜头拉回到故事里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're walking down towards 18th Street.
zh: 你正朝第18街的方向走去。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've just raised all this money.
zh: 你刚融到了这么一大笔钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: You feel like a king.
zh: 你感觉自己像个国王。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the way you did it.
zh: 你就是这么做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not just on paper.
zh: 不只是纸面上的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right.
zh: 对。

speaker: Unknown
en: It just, it didn't actually happen yet.
zh: 但实际上事情还没发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was, you said over the next year, that was the start of the end.
zh: 你说过，接下来那一年，那是终结的开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over the next three years, decisions changed.
zh: 接下来的三年里，决策变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Specifically in terms of business.
zh: 具体在生意方面。

speaker: Unknown
en: It became about money.
zh: 一切变成了关于钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: It became about money.
zh: 一切变成了关于钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: It became about valuation.
zh: 一切变成了关于估值。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that was.
zh: 然后就是……

speaker: Unknown
en: It forgot the mission.
zh: 它忘记了使命。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was a slippery slope.
zh: 那是一条滑坡。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not my truth.
zh: 这不是我的真相。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that means that you grew even faster?
zh: 也就是说你们增长得更快了？

speaker: Unknown
en: You opened up even more leases?
zh: 开启了更多的租约？

speaker: Unknown
en: We blew up.
zh: 我们爆发了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We went even faster.
zh: 我们更快了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We went really fast.
zh: 我们非常快。

speaker: Unknown
en: We went very fast.
zh: 我们特别快。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the things that I read or something from when I was doing the research is that you had lots of sort of tangential ideas at that time, maybe because of the money, things like surfing and...
zh: 我做研究的时候读到或看到的一件事是，你们当时有很多比较发散的想法，也许是因为有了钱，比如冲浪之类的……

speaker: Unknown
en: Fake news.
zh: 假新闻。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was before WeWork ever started.
zh: 这是在 WeWork 创立之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had all these ideas.
zh: 我有各种想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anybody who tells the story that we had a lot of ideas in 2016 because we raised money doesn't know that this was done before WeWork ever started in a green desk office.
zh: 任何讲我们 2016 年因为融到钱才有好多想法这个故事的人，都不知道这些早在 WeWork 创立之前、在一间 Green Desk 办公室里就已经完成了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all the ideas we had...
zh: 而我们当时有的所有想法……

speaker: Unknown
en: We're right here.
zh: 我们就在这儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: This doesn't look like focus to me.
zh: 这在我看来可不像专注。

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel like if I showed my investors this now, they would shout at me.
zh: 我感觉如果我现在把这个给我的投资人看，他们会冲我大喊大叫的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could be.
zh: 有可能。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today I would choose, what is the real focus of all these things?
zh: 今天我会选择，这一切之中真正的焦点是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: The person.
zh: 那个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we can actually, and I would do, today I would do it one foot ahead of the other.
zh: 如果我们真的能……而且我会，今天我会一步一步来。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a little bit more like we're doing flow.
zh: 会有点更像我们在做心流。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when you build a business, it's art, not science.
zh: 但当你创建一门生意时，它是艺术，不是科学。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're going to have some investor who tells you, oh, you put this first and this second and this third, they're limiting you.
zh: 如果有投资人告诉你，哦，你把这个放第一、这个放第二、这个放第三，那是在限制你。

speaker: Unknown
en: You do need to have a very strong foundation.
zh: 你确实需要一个非常坚实的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's, as you said before, both as a human being and as a business person.
zh: 而这，就像你之前说的，无论作为一个人类还是作为一个商业人士。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for anyone that can't see, you just circled the sort of stick person in the middle of all of these ideas.
zh: 所以给看不见的观众说明一下，你刚刚圈出了所有这些想法中间的那个火柴人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you said, really, I would have focused on this person.
zh: 然后你说，真的，我本应该专注在这个人身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would really have focused on the person and only added things that made...
zh: 我真的本应该专注于这个人，只添加那些能让……

speaker: Unknown
en: So we had a mission, create a world where people make a life and not just a living.
zh: 所以我们有一个使命，创造一个让人们是在经营生活而不仅仅是谋生的世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should have just only added things that are in support of that mission.
zh: 我们本应该只添加支持这个使命的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: It reminds me of Amazon and Jeff Bezos.
zh: 这让我想起 Amazon 和 Jeff Bezos。

speaker: Unknown
en: Their famous saying of working backwards from the customer.
zh: 他们那句著名的“从客户出发逆向工作”。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what's the customer's pain points?
zh: 客户的痛点是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I've just, we just hired a wonderful person, our CTIO from Amazon.
zh: 我刚刚，我们刚招了一位很棒的人，我们来自 Amazon 的 CTIO。

speaker: Unknown
en: She's called Arda.
zh: 她叫 Arda。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she says to me that at Amazon, there's always a, you know, often an empty seat to the meetings.
zh: 她告诉我，在 Amazon，开会时经常有一个空座位。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is the customer.
zh: 那是客户的座位。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they leave an empty seat so that they can make the decisions and,
zh: 所以他们留一个空座位，这样他们就能以……做出决策，

speaker: Unknown
en: through the lens of this person.
zh: 通过这个人的视角。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they're always in every meeting.
zh: 所以他们在每一次会议中都在场。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you don't get distracted of who you're doing it for.
zh: 这样你就不会搞混你在为谁做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's kind of what you described.
zh: 这有点像你描述的那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's actually become, you know, since she's joined our business, it's always friend of mine for all of us.
zh: 实际上，自从她加入我们的公司以来，这对我们所有人来说一直……是我的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just like work backwards from the customer.
zh: 就像从客户出发逆向工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because sometimes you might work forward from your own ego.
zh: 因为有时候你可能是从自己的自负出发正向工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I like that.
zh: 比如，我喜欢那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, I'm going to give you my best advice.
zh: 记住，我要给你我最好的建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've met, I've had the pleasure to meet Mr. Bezos and he's phenomenal.
zh: 我见过，我有幸见过 Bezos 先生，他非常了不起。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's one of the best operators on the planet by far.
zh: 他是这个星球上最顶尖的运营者之一，遥遥领先。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some would say the best.
zh: 有人会说这是最好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: My best advice for you,
zh: 我给你最好的建议是,

speaker: Unknown
en: build a culture that is authentic and true to you.
zh: 建立一种真实的、忠于你自己的文化。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I love that you're focusing on the customer, but I can tell as we're speaking, you're very honed in on your user.
zh: 所以我很喜欢你聚焦于客户,但我能看出来,在我们交谈的时候,你非常专注于你的用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: Multiple times you've told me how your listener is going to interpret what we're saying.
zh: 你多次告诉我,你的听众会如何理解我们说的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are aligned with your listener.
zh: 你和你的听众是对齐的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have no doubt about it.
zh: 对此我毫不怀疑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Isn't that a form of working backwards from the customer?
zh: 这难道不是一种从客户出发倒推的工作方式吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I'm sitting here thinking about 21-year-old Dave, Jenny, I'm thinking about, and every time you answer a question.
zh: 因为我坐在这里,想着 21 岁的 Dave、Jenny,我想着,你每次回答一个问题的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, I'm sorry.
zh: 再说一次,抱歉。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want to.
zh: 我不想。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, please do that.
zh: 不,请这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, we're being very, I'm repeating myself and I don't mean to be boring.
zh: 不,我们非常,我在重复自己,我不是有意要无聊。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if this was, if we did this podcast three years ago, maybe I would go all over the place.
zh: 而且,如果,如果我们三年前做这档播客,也许我会东拉西扯。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you actually today went to the depth of your truth, what is your correction?
zh: 如果你今天真的深入到你的真相之中,你的需要纠正的地方是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you need to work on?
zh: 你需要改进什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Where are you going?
zh: 你要往哪里去?

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you found that, and then you brought that back into your team, I am telling you, I don't even know how far it would be.
zh: 而当你找到了那个东西,然后把它带回你的团队,我告诉你,我都不知道那会走到多远。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you're saying I don't need to work backwards from the customer.
zh: 所以你是说我不需要从客户出发倒推。

speaker: Unknown
en: What are you saying?
zh: 你到底在说什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm saying your truth has to be yours first.
zh: 我是说,你的真相首先必须是你自己的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not pushing against this theory.
zh: 我并不是在反对这个理论。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we need to work.
zh: 当然,我们需要工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, my truth.
zh: 再说一次,我的真相。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know a lot of times people keep telling me what the customer wants.
zh: 我知道很多时候人们不断告诉我客户想要什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I, Rebecca and I build what we think is correct.
zh: 我,Rebecca 和我,我们构建我们认为正确的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't listen to the customer?
zh: 你不听客户的?

speaker: Unknown
en: No focus groups.
zh: 不做焦点小组。

speaker: Unknown
en: No way.
zh: 绝不。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a famous saying, I think it's Henry Ford, if I asked a customer, they would have asked for faster horses.

zh: 当你们达到我们约定的目标时，你和管理团队会从 30% 升到 51%,我们降到 49%。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I understand that we're growing too fast.
zh: 我知道我们增长得太快了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I understand that we'll have too much expenses, but I'm putting my money where my mouth is.
zh: 我知道我们会有太多开支，但我用真金白银支持我说的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I don't care because I think this is going to be one of the biggest companies in the world.
zh: 而且我不在乎，因为我认为这将成为世界上最大的公司之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: This happens is a very important part of the story.
zh: 这件事的发生是故事里非常重要的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: This happens in March of 2018.
zh: 这发生在 2018 年 3 月。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is before the IPO.
zh: 这是在 IPO 之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't bring this story back if you don't understand this part.
zh: 如果你不理解这一部分，你就没法把这段故事带回来。

speaker: Unknown
en: March of 2018, he only invested.
zh: 2018 年 3 月，他才刚刚投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: The money really came in in the middle of 2017.
zh: 钱实际上是 2017 年年中才到账的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're like you too.
zh: 我们就像你们一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is only a year after he's with us.
zh: 这才是在他和我们在一起仅一年之后。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's on the board.
zh: 他在董事会里。

speaker: Unknown
en: He has two boards.
zh: 他有两个董事席位。

speaker: Unknown
en: They know everything that's happening in the company.
zh: 他们知道公司里发生的一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: No secrets.
zh: 没有秘密。

speaker: Unknown
en: I take the offer to our board.
zh: 我把这个报价拿到我们的董事会。

speaker: Unknown
en: Say, look at this amazing thing.
zh: 说，看看这个了不起的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, they invested pre-money valuation of 84 million.

speaker: Unknown
en: This is 20 billion.
zh: 而这是 200 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: They invested at 84 million.
zh: 他们投资时估值是 8400 万。

speaker: Unknown
en: By this point, they've already pulled out because of all the secondaries.
zh: 到这个时候，因为所有这些老股转让，他们已经收回了——

speaker: Unknown
en: They've already pulled out somewhere between 300 to 500 million.
zh: 到这时候他们已经收回了大约 3 亿到 5 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll check the exact numbers so you have it maybe even more, maybe even 700 million by this.
zh: 我会去查确切数字，这样你们就有数据，也许更多，也许到这时候已经 7 亿了。

speaker: Unknown
en: They've pulled out a lot, whatever the number was, at least 350 million on an investment of 21 million.
zh: 他们已经撤出了很多，不管那个数字是多少，至少在 2100 万的投资上拿回了 3.5 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I take it to them, the offers.
zh: 我把报价拿给他们看。

speaker: Unknown
en: It must have sounds like a great offer.
zh: 这听起来一定像是个很棒的报价。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I, Adam, I'm going to stay in the company, I'm in the management team, so we can't make a deal like this.
zh: 但是我，Adam，我要留在这家公司，我在管理团队里，所以我们不能做这样一笔交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: So in boards, when someone has a deal that they're staying behind, you need to create a special committee.
zh: 所以在董事会里，当有人有交易但自己要留下时，你需要成立一个特别委员会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a special committee is created.
zh: 然后一个特别委员会就成立了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The board member from Benchmark and another board member that we had in the that we had, which out of respect to him, I'm not saying his name.
zh: 来自 Benchmark 的董事会成员，以及我们的另一位董事会成员——出于对他的尊重，我不说他的名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they create a special committee.
zh: 他们成立了特别委员会。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they decide to negotiate a $20 billion all cash deal that would have made money for everyone.
zh: 他们决定谈判一笔 200 亿美元的全现金交易，这本可以让所有人都赚钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, Masa came in at 20.
zh: 注：此处原文编号为 1909，无重复。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's the only one who's not making money from this deal and he's staying.
zh: 他是唯一一个没有从这笔交易中赚钱的人，而且他要留下。

speaker: Unknown
en: And everybody else came in at $50 million, $100 million, $400 million, $1 billion.
zh: 其他所有人都是在 5000 万、1 亿、4 亿、10 亿的时候进来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone's making money.
zh: 每个人都在赚钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there, and this word is a dangerous one, but it's greed.
zh: 而在这里——这个词很危险——是贪婪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because the company at that point is losing, well, $2 billion a year.
zh: 因为公司当时正在亏损，嗯，每年 20 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: Forecasted to lose over $3 billion the next year.
zh: 预测下一年亏损超过 30 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: He knows the forecast.
zh: 他知道这个预测。

speaker: Unknown
en: He wants to put $10 billion to give it run rate of three years so we can build whatever we want between the two of us.
zh: 他想投 100 亿美元，给它三年的 run rate，这样我们两个人可以一起随心所欲地搞建设。

speaker: Unknown
en: He'll be the majority shareholder.
zh: 他会成为大股东。

speaker: Unknown
en: They say no and negotiate a $20 billion deal from March till October.
zh: 他们说不，然后从三月谈到十月，谈一笔 200 亿的交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: For a company losing $2 billion, I don't know how you value companies.
zh: 对于一家年亏 20 亿的公司，我不知道你们怎么给公司估值。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can talk about how we should value companies because there are very valuable companies who are losing money, of course, at high growth.
zh: 我们可以聊聊我们应该怎么给公司估值，因为当然有非常有价值的公司在亏钱，在高增长的情况下。

speaker: Unknown
en: But still, they have a company losing $2 billion.
zh: 但即便如此，他们面对的是一家年亏 20 亿的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa's son is offering them $20 in return for that.
zh: Masa 的儿子提出用 200 亿来换这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pleasure.
zh: 荒唐。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they negotiate these two special committees, special board members.
zh: 而他们由这两个特别委员会、特别董事会成员去谈判。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I'm not part of it because I'm staying in the deal, so I have zero part of it.
zh: 我没有参与，因为我要留在这笔交易里，所以我完全没有参与。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a normal world, if I were to sit on your board,
zh: 在一个正常的世界里，如果我坐在你们的董事会里，

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm sitting on your board and someone comes and gives this crazy offer to buy me and all the other friends out.
zh: 而我坐在你们的董事会里，有人来了，给出这个疯狂的报价，要把我和其他所有朋友都买出去。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I invested in you now in this 400 million.
zh: 我在这笔 4 亿里投了资。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you gave me a deal at 20 billion.
zh: 而你们给我一笔 200 亿的交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm making 2-3 billion on my 50 million.
zh: 我用 5000 万赚了二三十亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: First, I come to you and I say, Stephen, thank you.
zh: 首先，我会来找你说，Stephen，谢谢你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for being such a great entrepreneur and doing this for me.
zh: 谢谢你成为这么伟大的创业者，为我做成这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's number one.
zh: 这是第一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: But number two, I say, Stephen.
zh: 但第二点，我会说，Stephen。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm a little offended that you don't want me with you anymore.
zh: 你不想让我继续陪你走下去，我有点受伤。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is this really what you want?
zh: 这真的是你想要的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you would tell me, yes, Adam, this is what I want.
zh: 如果你告诉我，是的，Adam，这就是我想要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is how A16C.
zh: 这就是 A16C。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is why they're so amazing.
zh: 这就是为什么他们如此了不起。

speaker: Unknown
en: They go with the founder.
zh: 他们站在创始人一边。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll tell you, Stephen, it's not what I wanted, but I'm grateful for all the money you've made for me.
zh: 我会告诉你，Stephen，这不是我想要的，但我很感激你为我赚的所有钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've worked extremely hard and I wish you good luck.
zh: 你工作得极其努力，我祝你好运。

speaker: Unknown
en: And maybe next time when you do your next business, come back to me again.
zh: 也许下次你做下一个生意的时候，再来找我。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't do that.
zh: 他们没那么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't ask me what I want, what I do.
zh: 他们不问我想什么、我要做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: They negotiate because they think they can push myself from 20 billion to 30.
zh: 他们去谈判，因为他们觉得自己能把价格从 200 亿推到 300 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Their number was 32 billion.
zh: 他们的数字是 320 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't know how they invented it.
zh: 他们自己也不知道这数字是怎么想出来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They were thinking 100 billion.
zh: 他们想的是 1000 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember, they're the same one sitting around the board that never gave the feedback on the technology.
zh: 记住，他们就是那几个坐在董事会里、却从没对技术给过任何反馈的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They've never done any of...
zh: 他们从来什么都没做过……

speaker: Unknown
en: They have one thing in their eyes and one thing only, and that's dollar signs.
zh: 他们眼里只有一样东西，也仅仅只有一样，那就是美元符号。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the problem with greed and dollar signs, if you're greedy, you even lose what you have in your hand.
zh: 但贪婪和美元符号的问题在于，如果你贪婪，你甚至会失去你手里已有的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they're negotiating this 20 billion.
zh: 于是他们开始谈判这个 200 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I must have from the first day said, guys, this is my final offer.
zh: 我从第一天起一定说过，各位，这是我的最终报价。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is no 21 billion, even 20 is crazy.
zh: 没有 210 亿，就连 200 亿都很疯狂。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's as high as I'm going to go because I believe in Adam and I believe in me and we're going to build together.
zh: 这是我能出的最高价了，因为我相信 Adam，我相信我自己，我们要一起把它做起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: They do that until October.
zh: 他们一直这样拖到十月。

speaker: Unknown
en: And somewhere around the end of September, beginning of October,
zh: 在九月底、十月初的某个时候，

speaker: Unknown
en: They realize he's not moving.
zh: 他们意识到他不会让步了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Stock market is starting to go down and Japan and this, and these growth businesses are starting to take a hit.
zh: 股市开始下跌，日本啊这些，这些增长型业务开始受到冲击。

speaker: Unknown
en: They see that things are changing, then they decide to engage and actually negotiate the deal.
zh: 他们看到情况在变化，然后才决定参与进来，真正开始谈判这笔交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: By the time they're done to document since December 24th, 2018.
zh: 等他们把文件做完，已经是 2018 年 12 月 24 日了。

speaker: Unknown
en: SoftBank stock is really down for reasons that had nothing to do with us.
zh: 软银的股价跌得很惨，原因是和我们毫无关系的。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is no world in which they could do a $20 billion cash deal and Masa still stays in his place.
zh: 在任何情况下，他们都不可能再做成一笔 200 亿美元的现金交易，而 Masa 还能保住自己的位置。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Masa calls me and said, Adam, I'm so sorry.
zh: Masa 打电话给我说，Adam，我非常抱歉。

speaker: Unknown
en: I cannot do the deal anymore.
zh: 我没办法再做这笔交易了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was offered in March.
zh: 交易是三月份提出来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, what these two board members should have done is gotten on a plane the next day, came to Masa's son and said, Masa,
zh: 再说一次，这两位董事会成员当时应该做的是第二天就登上飞机，去找 Masa 的儿子，对他说，Masa，

speaker: Unknown
en: Please sign.
zh: 请签字吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know everything about the board.
zh: 你对董事会的一切了如指掌。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're in the board.
zh: 你就在董事会里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't need any diligence.
zh: 你不需要任何尽调。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's our bank account.
zh: 这是我们的银行账户。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's the signature.
zh: 这是签名。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're disappointed we're not staying with Adam.
zh: 我们很遗憾不能继续和 Adam 在一起了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if that's what he wants and that's what you want, good luck to both of you.
zh: 但如果那是他想要的，也是你想要的，祝你们俩好运。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for the very fair price.
zh: 感谢你们给出了非常公道的价格。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll take our benchmark at the time, at least 2.4 billion they would have put.
zh: 我们会拿走我们当时的 Benchmark 份额，至少 24 亿，那是他们本来投入的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll take our cash and walk away.
zh: 我们会拿走我们的现金，然后走人。

speaker: Unknown
en: No.
zh: 不。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, Travis said very, in an interview, I just saw.
zh: 不，Travis 在一次采访里说得很清楚，我刚刚才看到。

speaker: Unknown
en: Travis.
zh: Travis。

speaker: Unknown
en: Travis Kalanick.
zh: Travis Kalanick。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being the CEO of Ubi, the founder of Ubi.
zh: Ubi 的 CEO，Ubi 的创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said that being an entrepreneur is like playing eight-dimensional chess.
zh: 他说，当创业者就像是下八维象棋。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being a venture capitalist is like watching the game.
zh: 当风险投资人就像是站在旁边看棋。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, remember, as you're choosing your investors, choose the one who play eight-dimensional chess, not the watchers.
zh: 再说一次，记住，当你在挑选投资人的时候，要选那个下八维象棋的人，而不是旁观者。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they didn't do that.
zh: 所以他们没有那样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa calls me.
zh: Masa 打电话给我。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's December.
zh: 那是十二月。

speaker: Unknown
en: He says, I can't do the deal.
zh: 他说，我做不成这笔交易了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I actually understand him.
zh: 而我其实理解他。

speaker: Unknown
en: I actually say, I understand because they did waste all that time.
zh: 我确实说了，我理解，因为他们确实浪费了那么多时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I found myself in trouble.
zh: 然后我发现自己陷入了麻烦。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because from when he offered the deal, remember, he was going to have 70%, we were going to have 30%.
zh: 因为从他提出这笔交易的时候起，记住，他原本要占 70%，我们要占 30%。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the goal was a revenue goal that we needed to.
zh: 而目标是一个我们需要达成的营收目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were already all working towards that goal.
zh: 我们当时已经全员都在朝着那个目标努力了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We signed the leases.
zh: 我们签了租约。

speaker: Unknown
en: We made the commitments.
zh: 我们做出了承诺。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were already rushing.
zh: 我们当时已经在赶了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We found ourselves in a way that if we weren't to, he gave the $2 billion because to try not to really ruin the business.
zh: 我们发现自己处于这样一种境地:如果我们不这么做,他给了那 20 亿美元,是为了尽量不真正毁掉这门生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's already put a lot of money in the business already.
zh: 他已经往这门生意里投了很多钱了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We found ourselves being forced to go public.
zh: 我们发现自己被迫上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we actually went public when we weren't ready.
zh: 所以我们其实是在没准备好的情况下上市的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what actually happened.
zh: 实际发生的就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's very important, this piece of the story, because without that context, then you don't understand.
zh: 所以这段故事非常重要,因为如果没有那个背景,你就无法理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: And again, it's back to all the founders you're talking about.
zh: 再说一次,这又回到你聊的那些创始人身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You got to choose your investors wisely, because if you choose the wrong investors, when the time counts for that big move, if they're not going to prioritize you, they're going to do what's best for them and everybody's going to lose.
zh: 你必须明智地选择投资人,因为如果你选错了投资人,到了需要那步大棋的关键时刻,如果他们不把你放在优先位置,他们会做对自己最有利的事,所有人都会输。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why weren't you ready?
zh: 而如果创始人没准备好,公司就没准备好。

speaker: Unknown
en: To go public?
zh: 上市?

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 对。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now you're going back to systems.
zh: 现在你要回到系统问题上。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were growing way too fast.
zh: 我们增长得太快了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our tech was not catching up with us, so we couldn't measure things correctly.
zh: 我们的技术没跟上我们,所以我们没办法正确地衡量各种事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: We, there's this thing called SOX compliant when you go public.
zh: 我们,有个东西叫 SOX 合规,上市的时候要用到。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our systems weren't able to do the thing I told you before, to show that one building is profitable, but the neighborhood is not.
zh: 我们的系统没法做我之前跟你说的那件事,没法显示某一栋楼是盈利的,但整个社区不盈利。

speaker: Unknown
en: One city is profitable, but the state is not.
zh: 某一个城市是盈利的,但整个州不盈利。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wasn't able to divide.
zh: 它没办法做这种划分。

speaker: Unknown
en: But now, in hindsight, connecting to what we talked today, I, Adam, wasn't ready.
zh: 但现在,事后回想,联系到我们今天聊的内容,我,Adam,当时没准备好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if the founder is not ready, the business is not ready.
zh: 而且如果创始人还没准备好，业务也就没准备好。

speaker: Unknown
en: By the way, I tried to push not to go public.
zh: 顺便说一句,我曾努力推动不要上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: Master called me, said, please don't go public.
zh: Masa 打电话给我,说,请不要上市。

speaker: Unknown
en: All day.
zh: 一整天。

speaker: Unknown
en: people around me, some of them that came after this point and not all, but a lot of them were all go public, go public, go public.
zh: 我身边的人,有些是在这件事之后来的,不是所有人,但其中很多人都是,上市吧,上市吧,上市吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was getting pushed by the wrong people back to surround yourself with the wrong people.
zh: 我被错误的人推着走,又回到了要选对身边的人这个话题。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we weren't ready.
zh: 但我们没准备好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the timeline is pretty crazy because obviously COVID is around the corner here.
zh: 但这个时间线挺疯狂的,因为显然 COVID 就在眼前了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's called COVID-19 for a reason.
zh: 它叫 COVID-19 是有原因的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're in, that's at the end of 2018.
zh: 而我们处在,那是 2018 年底。

speaker: Unknown
en: You file.
zh: 你提交了文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: In January, SoftBank does invest a further $2 billion into WeWork.
zh: 1 月,SoftBank 确实又向 WeWork 追加了 20 亿美元投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: That $2 billion was because they passed on the deal before.
zh: 那 20 亿美元是因为他们之前错过了那笔交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not because we filed.
zh: 不是因为我们提交了文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was kind of a, I guess, compensation.
zh: 所以那算是一种,我猜,补偿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Respect between Masa and myself.
zh: Masa 和我之间的尊重。

en: Another great deal that Masa sent it, that he didn't have to.
zh: Masa 送出的又一笔很棒的交易,他本来不必这么做的。

en: In May 2019, you have almost 500 locations, 400,000 members, 12,000 employees around the world.
zh: 2019 年 5 月,你们有将近 500 个办公地点,40 万名会员,全球 12000 名员工。

en: And then in August 2019, WeWork publicly filed its S1.
zh: 然后在 2019 年 8 月,WeWork 公开提交了它的 S1 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: The company valued at around $47 billion.
zh: 公司估值约 470 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: The WeWork, the S1 showed some losses.
zh: WeWork,那个 S1 显示了一些亏损。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of losses, not some losses.
zh: 很多亏损,不是一些亏损。

speaker: Unknown
en: Showed the truth.
zh: 显示了真相。

speaker: Unknown
en: The company was losing money.
zh: 公司在亏钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Showed that WeWork had lost $690 million in the first six months of 2019, bringing the total losses to almost $3 billion in the past three years.
zh: 显示 WeWork 在 2019 年前六个月亏损了 6.9 亿美元,使过去三年的总亏损接近 30 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: WeWork was making losses of $219k every hour it operated.
zh: WeWork 每运营一小时就亏损 21.9 万美元。

en: The S1 revealed that you'd also trademarked the word we and sold it back to the company.
zh: S1 还披露,你们也注册了 "we" 这个词的商标,然后又把它卖回给了公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not true.
zh: 那不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which you deny?
zh: 你要否认吗?
