en: No, no, it's not.
zh: 不,不,不是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not true.
zh: 那不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, no, no, it's not denying.
zh: 不,不,不,这不是否认。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want, we can talk about there's a story, but that's not what happened.
zh: 如果你愿意,我们可以谈谈,是有一个故事,但事情不是那样发生的。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, no, if it's not true, it's not true.
zh: 不,不,如果不是真的,就不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't really care about the stuff.
zh: 我真的不在乎这些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是。

speaker: Unknown
en: But again, all these little details, just so we understand, just for the founders who are watching, right?
zh: 但再说一次,所有这些小细节,只是为了让我们理解,为了让正在观看的创始人们理解,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So now you're telling a story about something that happened to me.
zh: 所以现在你在讲一个发生在我身上的事情的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's supposed to be huge emotion that I'm supposed to have with this.
zh: 按理说我应该对此有强烈的情绪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even if it's not correct, if it's what people said, some of it is correct, not correct, so much context is missing.
zh: 即便它不准确,即便那是人们说的,其中有些是对的,有些不对,很多背景被遗漏了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not the point.
zh: 这不是重点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Life is not about what other people say or what the press say or even what you say.
zh: 人生不是关于别人怎么说、媒体怎么说、甚至你怎么说。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's about what kind of person I know I am.
zh: 而是关于我知道自己是什么样的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason I want to tell this to you and to the listeners is...
zh: 我之所以想把这件事讲给你和听众们听,是因为……

speaker: Unknown
en: We can all be that person.
zh: 我们都可以成为那样的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Please keep going.
zh: 请继续。

en: September 2019, WeWork announced it was postponing its IPO as a result of investors questioning the company.
zh: 2019 年 9 月,WeWork 宣布推迟 IPO,原因是投资者对公司的质疑。

en: And then, I mean, around this time, COVID shows up.
zh: 然后,我是说,大约在这个时候,COVID 出现了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I had to choose to step down.
zh: 所以我必须选择卸任。 [[2069/2076]] 人们有时认为我是被解雇的,因为《华尔街日报》是这么说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: People sometimes think I was fired because the Wall Street Journal said so.
zh: 人们有时以为我被解雇了，因为《华尔街日报》是这么说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not true.
zh: 不是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step down, I had full control.
zh: 卸任,我拥有完全控制权。

speaker: Unknown
en: Control the board and control the... Why did you step down?
zh: 控制董事会,控制……你为什么卸任?

speaker: Unknown
en: So if when people understand the context, and again, this is an old story, but I'm happy to go there.
zh: 如果人们理解了背景——再说一次,这是个老故事,但我很乐意讲——

speaker: Unknown
en: The only reason a person in control chooses to step down is because they think that it's the best choice.
zh: 一个有控制权的人选择卸任的唯一原因,是因为他们认为这是最好的选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the time, and again, this is part, by the way, of the play, this is the same playbook, but now we're going to say his name again, Travis, the founder of Uber.
zh: 当时——顺便说一句,这也是那套打法的一部分,同一本剧本,不过现在我们要再提一次他的名字,Travis,Uber 的创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Famously, Bill Gurley comes and puts a piece of paper in front of him.
zh: 众所周知,Bill Gurley 走过来,把一张纸放在他面前。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's Bill Galley.
zh: 他是 Bill Galley。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's one of the benchmark partners.
zh: 他是 benchmark 的合伙人之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: He famously puts a piece of paper in front of him, I think, and either you step down or we do this, this and this, some threat that makes him step down.
zh: 众所周知,我想是他把一张纸放在他面前,要么你卸任,要么我们就做这个、这个和这个,某种威胁使他卸任。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a different version of it, but they're pushing me very, very hard to step down.
zh: 我遇到的是另一个版本,但他们非常、非常用力地逼我卸任。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at the beginning, I'm like, I'm not stepping down.
zh: 一开始,我说,我不会卸任。

en: And then I have a meeting with one of the heads of the two biggest banks in the world.
zh: 然后我和世界上两家最大银行之一的负责人见了一次面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he sits with me and he says to me, Adam, if you step down...
zh: 他和我坐在一起,对我说,Adam,如果你卸任……

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we will fund $2 billion into WeWork, which will give it time to move profitable.
zh: 那么我们会向 WeWork 注入 20 亿美元,这将给它时间走向盈利。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step down, by the way, from being CEO, become chairman.
zh: 卸任,顺便说一句,是从 CEO 的位置上卸任,成为董事长。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I at the time had personal debt, which is a story for another time.
zh: 而我当时背负着个人债务,那是另一个故事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I had personal debt of $460 million to that bank and to other banks.
zh: 但我欠那家银行和其他银行 4.6 亿美元的个人债务。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, but what about my personal debt?
zh: 我说,那我的个人债务怎么办?

speaker: Unknown
en: My board member was next to me.
zh: 我的董事会成员就坐在我旁边。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the guy who runs my family office was next to me.
zh: 管理我家族办公室的人也坐在我旁边。

speaker: Unknown
en: We said, what about our personal debt?
zh: 我们说,那我们的个人债务怎么办?

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, don't worry about it.
zh: 他说,不用担心这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll figure it out.
zh: 我们会想办法解决的。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was also an advisor to my board, and he came in front of the whole board, and he said, I spoke to the bank.
zh: 还有一位我董事会的外部顾问，他来到整个董事会面前，说，我和银行谈过了。

speaker: Unknown
en: They said, it's all good.
zh: 他们说，一切都没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything will work out.
zh: 一切都会好起来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I stepped down out of choice because I thought it was going to fund WeWork.
zh: 所以我是自愿卸任的，因为我以为这笔钱会资助 WeWork。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought it was going to take care of Massa.
zh: 我以为它会照顾好 Masa。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought it was going to take care of the employees.
zh: 我以为它会照顾好员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought it was going to take care of everybody.
zh: 我以为它会照顾好所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it sounded like it was in the best of everybody.
zh: 听起来这是对所有人都最好的选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I wasn't going away.
zh: 但我并没有离开。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was just stepping down from being CEO and becoming executive chairman.
zh: 我只是卸下 CEO 职位，转任执行董事长。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do the board call.
zh: 我开了董事会电话会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I step down.
zh: 我卸任了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And 10 minutes later, a legal letter comes from the bank.
zh: 10 分钟后，银行发来一封法律函件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And basically says, because of your breach of contract, because it's change of control, something very technical, something we talked about to them before, and they said no problem, but we didn't have it in writing.
zh: 大意是说，由于你违反了合同，因为发生了控制权变更，一些非常技术性的条款，我们之前和他们谈过的东西，他们说没问题，但我们没有把它落在书面上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because of your...
zh: 由于你的……

speaker: Unknown
en: breach of contract.
zh: 违反合同。

speaker: Unknown
en: And because you had the change of control, you now have 15 days to pay us back our debt, that 460 million, or we will take your shares.
zh: 而且由于发生了控制权变更，你们现在有 15 天时间偿还我们的债务，那 4.6 亿美元，否则我们将拿走你的股份。

speaker: Unknown
en: And because of my super voting rights, my shares were five to one, which means that by taking away my shares, they would have taken control over the company.
zh: 而由于我的超级投票权，我的股份是五比一的，这意味着拿走我的股份，他们就会取得对公司的控制权。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, what I'm describing to you, and you talked a lot about founders, but you didn't know a lot of the names.
zh: 现在，我跟你描述的这些，你谈了很多创始人，但你并不了解很多名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's important to know the names and the history because I'm not describing to you something that happened for the first time.
zh: 了解这些名字和这段历史很重要，因为我向你描述的并不是第一次发生的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: This famously happened to multiple entrepreneurs in history.
zh: 这在历史上著名地发生在多位企业家身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: This used to be the venture capital playbook.
zh: 这曾经是风险投资的标准操作手册。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, there is a new crop of venture capitalists, and they're very different.
zh: 今天，有一批新的风险投资家，他们非常不一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: But old school venture capital, a lot of times, this is how it used to go.
zh: 但老派的风险投资，很多时候，过去就是这么运作的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was the surprise.
zh: 那就是意外所在。

speaker: Unknown
en: I stepped down because I thought it was the best for everybody.
zh: 我卸任是因为我以为这对所有人都最好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a second after I did it, we got stabbed in the back.
zh: 而我这么做的下一秒，我们就被背后捅了一刀。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the only lesson there, if you're going to stab the king...
zh: 而那里唯一的教训是，如果你要刺杀国王……

speaker: Unknown
en: kill.
zh: 就要杀掉。 [[2129-错?编号不变]]

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're not going to kill, we're going to take a deep breath.
zh: 如果你没杀掉，我们就要深吸一口气。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to learn our lessons.
zh: 我们要吸取教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to know what's really important in life.
zh: 我们要明白人生中真正重要的是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to come back again.
zh: 我们要再次卷土重来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what actually happened there.
zh: 而那里实际发生的就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the only reason the story is a little challenging for you is because we never corrected it publicly.
zh: 这段故事对你来说之所以有点难以理解，唯一的原因是我们从未公开澄清过它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason we corrected some of it, but not all of it.
zh: 而我们澄清了一部分，但不是全部。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason we didn't correct it publicly, for what?
zh: 而我们之所以没有公开澄清，是为了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: For what?
zh: 为了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: For what?
zh: 为了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: The best way I can talk about the past is by what I do today, by how we're speaking right now, by how my kids are, by the businesses I build, by the nonprofit I do, by the friendships I have, by the relationships I hold.
zh: 我谈论过去最好的方式，是通过我今天所做的事，通过我们此刻的交谈，通过我孩子们的样子，通过我建立的事业，通过我做的非营利组织，通过我拥有的友谊，通过我维护的关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reason a lot of entrepreneurs come to take money from us, and again, we don't invest anymore, but we have a huge inbound of people wanting us to invest in them, is because we don't talk about our successes all the time.
zh: 而很多企业家来找我们拿钱的原因——再说一次，我们已经不投资了，但我们有大量主动找上门来想让我们投资的人——是因为我们不会总谈论自己的成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: We talk about the lessons.
zh: 我们谈论的是教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: Measure us by how we're going to be next to you when time is very tough.
zh: 用在非常艰难的时刻我们会如何陪在你身边来衡量我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's what actually happened there.
zh: 所以那里实际发生的就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I found myself out of it very quickly.
zh: 而我很快就从中脱身了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And from there, without making the story confused, Masa came.
zh: 从那以后，为了不让这个故事变得更混乱，Masa 来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa saved the day.
zh: Masa 挽救了局面。

speaker: Unknown
en: He paid the debt to all the banks, 460 million.
zh: 他向所有银行偿还了债务，4.6 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in return, I gave him my control of the company.
zh: 作为回报，我把对公司的控制权给了他。

speaker: Unknown
en: I gave him whatever he asked for because we were done and the company was done.
zh: 我给了他想要的一切，因为我们已经完蛋了，公司也完蛋了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he came to save it.
zh: 而他是来拯救它的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the rest was running under them.
zh: 然后剩下的业务就在他们手下运营了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You get an email from the bank within sort of, I think it was nine minutes I read.
zh: 你会在九分钟内收到银行的邮件，我记得我读到的是九分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nine minutes.
zh: 九分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nine minutes asking for you to immediately repay, I think, was it about $450 million?
zh: 九分钟，要求你立即还款，我记得大概是4.5亿美元？

speaker: Unknown
en: $450 million compounding daily because you're in default.
zh: 4.5亿美元，按日计息，因为你已经违约了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just for anyone that doesn't know what compounding daily means.
zh: 给不知道按日复利是什么意思的人解释一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I have 435...
zh: 所以我有435……

speaker: Unknown
en: If you read it, it's only for my Rick Rubin interview, because the first time I said it was only a few months ago.
zh: 如果你读到过，那只是在我的 Rick Rubin 访谈里，因为我第一次讲这个也只是几个月前。

speaker: Unknown
en: I never spoke about this.
zh: 我从来没说过这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Compounding daily means every day...
zh: 按日复利的意思是每一天……

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you have debt of 10% annual, or let's do 12, so it's easy, which would calculate to 1% a month just to keep things really easy.
zh: 所以如果你有一笔年利率10%的债务，或者算12%吧，这样容易算，那就是每月1%，为了保持简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: Compounding daily is when your debt suddenly goes back then, I think it's 5% became 50%.
zh: 按日复利就是你的债务突然回到那时，我记得是5%变成了50%。

speaker: Unknown
en: 15 and you calculate it on daily increments.
zh: 15，然后你按每日增量来计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: So each time it compounds again and again and again, it ends up that when you do the calculation for the year, it's more than the debt number.
zh: 所以每次它一次又一次地复利，结果就是当你算全年的账时，会超过债务的本金数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your debt is growing by more than a million a day.
zh: 你的债务每天增长超过一百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, it's not.
zh: 不，没有那么快。

speaker: Unknown
en: We would have to do the math.
zh: 我们得算一算。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a million there.
zh: 没到一百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's say it's 15%.
zh: 但假设是15%。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's just use clean numbers.
zh: 我们就用整数吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's say it's 15% over 400 million, which would have been 60 million.
zh: 假设是4亿以上的15%，那就是6000万。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's actually more than 60 million.
zh: 实际上比6000万还多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you divide it to it, it's huge numbers that we don't have money to pay.
zh: 如果你除一下，那是巨大的数字，我们没有钱去偿还。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so you have no money.
zh: 好，所以你没有钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: No money.
zh: 没有钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the bank have asked you for 400, let's say 450 million.
zh: 而银行要求你拿出4亿，比如说4.5亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: And gave us 15 days to pay.
zh: 并给了我们15天的时间付款。

speaker: Unknown
en: Giving you 15 days to pay.
zh: 给你15天付款。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or they take everything.
zh: 否则他们拿走一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: You say, this is what broke me.
zh: 你说过，这就是击垮我的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: When did I say that?
zh: 我什么时候说过？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think you said on the podcast.
zh: 我记得你是在播客里说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, you said on the podcast, you said, this is what broke me.
zh: 对，你在播客里说的，你说，这就是击垮我的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was a direct quote.
zh: 那是直接引语。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know if I meant, I wonder if it meant I was broke, because I don't think that's what broke me.
zh: 我不确定我是否是想说我破产了，因为我觉得那并不是真正击垮我的东西。

en: You described waking up in the middle of the night crying because you thought you had lost everything.
zh: 你描述过半夜醒来哭泣，因为你以为自己失去了一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes, that's more accurate.
zh: 是的，那个更准确。

speaker: Unknown
en: So at the moment when that happens, we were okay.
zh: 所以在那件事发生的那一刻，我们还好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Few days later, I wake up in the middle of the night next to Rebecca crying.
zh: 几天后，我在半夜醒来，躺在 Rebecca 旁边哭泣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, we talked about my childhood.
zh: 现在，我们聊过我的童年。

speaker: Unknown
en: We talked to you and I today about my childhood.
zh: 今天我和你聊过我的童年。

speaker: Unknown
en: We didn't get the tears out.
zh: 眼泪没有流出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't cry.
zh: 我不哭。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not for that.
zh: 不会为那种事哭。

speaker: Unknown
en: First time Rebecca ever sees me cry.
zh: 这是 Rebecca 第一次看到我哭。

speaker: Unknown
en: She looks at me and she's like, why are you crying?
zh: 她看着我，说，你为什么哭？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, we lost everything.
zh: 我说，我们失去了一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that's what I said there.
zh: 我想那就是我在那儿说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, we lost everything.
zh: 我说，我们失去了一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, what do you mean everything?
zh: 她说，你说的“一切”是什么意思？

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, everything.
zh: 我说，一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, the cars?
zh: 她说，车呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, the wheels on the car.
zh: 我说，连车上的轮子都没了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything.
zh: 一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: I goes, yeah, but remember we said you're going to put 100 million on my name just in case.
zh: 我说，对，但你还记得吗，我们说过为了以防万一，你要在我名下放一亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, yeah, I remember.
zh: 我说，对，我记得。

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, and at least we have that.
zh: 她说，那至少我们还有那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, I never did it.
zh: 我说，我从来没做。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, you never did that.
zh: 我说，你没做过那件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, never did.
zh: 我说，从来没做过。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, okay, but it's no problem.
zh: 他说，好吧，但这没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You didn't sign a personal guarantee.
zh: 你没有签个人担保。

speaker: Unknown
en: We said you'd never sign a personal guarantee.
zh: 我们说过你绝不签个人担保。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, I signed the personal guarantee.
zh: 我说，我签了个人担保。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a long story how that happened, but I signed.
zh: 那是怎么发生的说来话长，但我签了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, this is why who you marry is so important.
zh: 再说一次，这就是为什么你娶谁如此重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: How many partners do you know who a second ago thought they were worth whatever that number was and lived a high life and find out in one minute, no preparation, that not only is it all gone, it's all gone.
zh: 你认识多少个伴侣，一秒钟之前还以为自己拥有那个数字的财富、过着奢华的生活，然后在一分钟之内，毫无准备地发现不仅全没了，而且全都没了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And on top of the fact that it's all gone, the promises that was made to them in the relationship were not kept.
zh: 更何况在一切都没了之外，他们在关系中被许下的承诺也没有兑现。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's gone and money was not put aside and a personal guarantee was signed.
zh: 所以钱没了，也没有留出钱来，而且还签了个人担保。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if I'm signing a personal guarantee, I'm signing for both of us who are married.
zh: 因为如果我签了个人担保，我是在为我们这两个结婚的人一起签字。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a personal guarantee was signed that was agreed to not to sign.
zh: 而一份说好不签的个人担保却被签了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is why you have to choose your partner really well.
zh: 这就是为什么你必须非常认真地选择你的伴侣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Choose your partner for the day something like that happens, not for any other day.
zh: 选择你的伴侣，是为了某一天发生那种事的时候，而不是为了其他任何日子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm lucky that I chose well or she chose me or the universe chose us.
zh: 我很幸运我选对了，或者她选对了我，或者宇宙选中了我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: She looks at me and she goes, hmm.
zh: 她看着我，然后说，嗯。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, this is a surprise.
zh: 好吧，这真是个意外。

speaker: Unknown
en: My mom owns a house in upstate New York.
zh: 我妈在纽约州北部有一栋房子。

speaker: Unknown
en: She bought it 30 years ago.
zh: 她三十年前买的。

speaker: Unknown
en: She has no mortgage.
zh: 没有房贷。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's go live with my mom.
zh: 我们去和我妈一起住吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take a few months, think about it.
zh: 花几个月时间，好好想想。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want to go back into business, I know you'll be successful.
zh: 如果你想重新创业，我知道你会成功的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you don't, we'll move to Costa Rica.
zh: 如果你不想，我们就搬去哥斯达黎加。

speaker: Unknown
en: I will homeschool.
zh: 我来在家教育孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we will serve every morning and serve every night.
zh: 我们每天早上冲浪，每天晚上冲浪。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we'll have a great life.
zh: 我们会过上很棒的生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: Both cases, don't worry about it.
zh: 两种情况都不用担心。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at that moment,
zh: 而在那一刻，

speaker: Unknown
en: This is when I think I grow up for the first time.
zh: 我想那是我第一次真正长大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you asked about this and I was weird talking, you're helping me understand something.
zh: 你问到了这个，我说得有点语无伦次，你在帮我看清一些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You talked about the child and the pain.
zh: 你谈到了那个孩子和那种痛苦。

speaker: Unknown
en: As a child, when we're facing these very difficult things, we have no one to count on.
zh: 作为孩子，当我们面对这些非常艰难的事情时，我们没有人可以依靠。

speaker: Unknown
en: Only our parents.
zh: 只有我们的父母。

speaker: Unknown
en: For a moment, I think I was the child again crying.
zh: 有那么一刻，我想我又变回了那个哭泣的孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I wasn't a child anymore because I had an amazing wife and kids that I could lean back on.
zh: 但我已经不再是孩子了，因为我有一位了不起的妻子和孩子们可以依靠。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have my back even if I messed up, even if I didn't keep my word, even if I didn't do things the way they're supposed to, even if I took all the potential in the world and messed it up or lost it, even though it was ours for the taking.
zh: 即使我搞砸了，即使我没有信守承诺，即使我没有按应该的方式去做事，即使我把世上所有的潜力都搞砸了或弄丢了，尽管那本是我们唾手可得的，他们仍然支持着我。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the moment I realized that, I felt a little stronger.
zh: 而当我意识到那一刻，我感觉自己强大了一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I felt better.
zh: 我感觉好多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I stopped crying.
zh: 我不哭了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, okay.
zh: 我说，好吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: But Rebecca sees that I'm still not smiling.
zh: 但 Rebecca 看到我仍然没笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, by the way, when I met you, you were broke.
zh: 她说，顺便说一句，我认识你的时候，你破产了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think you're much more sexy when you're broke.
zh: 我觉得你破产的时候性感多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I smiled.
zh: 然后我笑了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now I was happy.
zh: 现在我开心了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I walked downstairs and now you're completing the story from before that morning after when I go to my three employees.
zh: 然后我走下楼，现在你要把之前那个故事讲完，就是那天早上之后，我去找我的三个员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two things happened before that morning.
zh: 在那个早上之前，发生了两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: One was the story with the spiritual teacher who taught me that the darkest moment of the night is a second before dawn.
zh: 第一是那个灵性导师的故事，他教会我，黑夜最黑暗的时刻是黎明前的一秒。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that belief is measured when we're down, not when we're up.
zh: 而且这个信念是在我们处于低谷时被检验的，不是在我们风光的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And two, I knew that I could rely on Rebecca, which means I had a foundation and I had a real partner and I can make it through anything.
zh: 第二，我知道我可以依靠 Rebecca，这意味着我有了根基，我有了一个真正的伴侣，我可以挺过任何事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when those...
zh: 所以当那些……

speaker: Unknown
en: When my three employees said, why are you smiling?
zh: 当我的三个员工说，你为什么在笑？

speaker: Unknown
en: They didn't add everything.
zh: 他们没有把所有事都说全。

speaker: Unknown
en: I told them the darkest moment of the night is a second before dawn, and I believe.
zh: 我告诉他们，黑夜最黑暗的时刻是黎明前的一秒，而且我相信这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I also told them, and my wife thinks I'm sexy.
zh: 但我还告诉他们，而且我老婆觉得我很性感。

speaker: Unknown
en: For a kid that didn't have much stability, that was a moment where you realized your foundation was probably rock solid, I think.
zh: 对于一个从小没什么稳定感的孩子来说，那一刻你意识到你的根基可能是坚如磐石的，我想。

speaker: Unknown
en: I go back to where you started.
zh: 我回到你开头说的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: Biggest decision any of us can make in our life is who is our partner.
zh: 我们任何人一生中能做的最大决定，就是我们的伴侣是谁。

speaker: Unknown
en: And how do we know who they are?
zh: 而我们怎么知道他们是什么样的人？

speaker: Unknown
en: We now said two things.
zh: 第二，在那非常艰难的一天，当一切都失去了，剩下的不只是我们好的一面时，他们会怎么样？

speaker: Unknown
en: One, do they make us the best version of ourselves?
zh: 第一，他们是否让我们成为最好的自己？

speaker: Unknown
en: Two, how will they be in that very tough day if everything was gone and all that is left is not only our nice side.
zh: 第二,如果一切都消失了,只剩下不只是我们美好的一面,他们在那样非常艰难的日子里会怎样。

speaker: Unknown
en: We talked before about the dark side and the light side.
zh: 我们之前谈过黑暗面和光明面。

speaker: Unknown
en: How are they gonna treat us if for a moment it's just the dark side?
zh: 如果有那么一刻只剩下黑暗面，他们会怎么对待我们？

speaker: Unknown
en: If the light is not turned off, but diminished.
zh: 而我可能会有一秒钟不高兴。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can see all the emotion in your face when you recount that moment and how much that means to you.
zh: 我能看到你讲述那个时刻时脸上全部的情绪，以及那对你意味着多少。

speaker: Unknown
en: Probably more so than anything else you've said.
zh: 可能比你说过的其他任何事都更明显。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sometimes Rebecca is quick to anger with me.
zh: 有时 Rebecca 对我很容易发火。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I can be upset for a second.
zh: 我可以生气一会儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when I have a second to take a deep breath and remember how, what a great wife I have and what a great partner I have, there's nothing she can do that can actually keep me upset for more than a little bit.
zh: 但当我有一秒钟深呼吸，想起我有一个多么好的妻子、多么好的伴侣，她做什么都没法真正让我不高兴超过一小会儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because our relationship has been testing fire.
zh: 因为我们的关系经受住了烈火的考验。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's another remarkable story I remember you saying about her giving you some advice to stand your ground in the post-WeWork era where there was negotiations still going on about, I think, your compensation that you're going to get.
zh: 我还记得你说过另一个关于她的了不起的故事，她给了你一些建议，让你在 WeWork 之后的时代坚守立场，当时关于你能拿到的报酬还在谈判中，我记得。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she gave you some really, really good advice about standing your ground.
zh: 她给了你一些非常非常好的关于坚守立场的建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: She did.
zh: 确实如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was that, for those that haven't heard that story?
zh: 那是什么样的建议，给那些没听过那个故事的人讲讲？

speaker: Unknown
en: It inspired me because, you know, I do tend to think my fiancée's always right.
zh: 这激励了我，因为，你知道，我往往觉得我的未婚妻总是对的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when I heard that, I thought, huh.
zh: 所以当我听到那个，我想，嗯。

speaker: Unknown
en: So first of all, it's very hard to stand our ground when we think we have a lot to lose.
zh: 首先，当我们觉得自己有很多东西要失去时，坚守立场是非常难的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's back to that fear.
zh: 又回到了那种恐惧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Rebecca has many superpowers.
zh: Rebecca 有很多超能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of them, she has no fear.
zh: 其中之一，她毫无恐惧。

speaker: Unknown
en: To a fault.
zh: 甚至到有点过分的程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: She's all truth.
zh: 她全是真实。

speaker: Unknown
en: She sees people for who they are.
zh: 她看人看到的是他们的本质。

speaker: Unknown
en: And therefore she's honest and she's not afraid of her truth.
zh: 因此她诚实，而且她不害怕自己的真实。

speaker: Unknown
en: If someone's not going to be our friend, if someone's not going to talk to us because of it, she doesn't care.
zh: 如果有人因此不打算做我们的朋友，如果有人因此不打算跟我们说话，她不在乎。

speaker: Unknown
en: She calls it as it is.
zh: 她有一说一。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at the end of this whole negotiation, when it came time to finish everything,
zh: 而在整场谈判的最后，当要收尾一切的时候，

speaker: Unknown
en: My litigator at the time, today is my partner, his name is Eric Seiler, he called me and we talked and we said and said, I think we can get to a deal.
zh: 我当时的诉讼律师——今天是我的合伙人——他叫 Eric Seiler，他打电话给我，我们谈了又谈，我说，我觉得我们能达成协议。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we talked about the deal and we got to the deal.
zh: 我们谈了这笔交易，然后我们达成了交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: With her, between her and her.
zh: 跟她，在她和她之间。

speaker: Unknown
en: So fast to finish for the story for everyone, I stepped down, the world,
zh: 快速把故事给所有人讲完，我卸任了，全世界，

speaker: Unknown
en: I get the letter from the bank.
zh: 我收到了银行的信。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have nothing.
zh: 我们一无所有。

speaker: Unknown
en: Masa-san comes in, saves the day, funds the company, funds us, pays our debt.
zh: Masa 先生出现了，力挽狂澜，给公司注资，给我们注资，偿还我们的债务。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we don't get money, but we don't get the big number.
zh: 但我们拿不到钱，但我们拿不到那个大数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: And agrees in April 1st, 2020, to pay myself and all the other investors $3 billion cash, out of which we would have been 30%.
zh: 并同意在 2020 年 4 月 1 日，支付我自己和所有其他投资者 30 亿美元现金，其中我们会占 30%。

speaker: Unknown
en: So $1 billion for us.
zh: 所以是 10 亿美元给我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Corona happens really in March.
zh: 新冠疫情实际上是在三月份爆发的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And on the last day of March 2020, we had a letter from SoftBank saying that this is force majeure.
zh: 而在 2020 年三月的最后一天，我们收到了软银的一封信，说这属于不可抗力。

speaker: Unknown
en: For those of you who don't know what force majeure means, it's when an event happens that's greater than life, that's out of control, like a flood or something.
zh: 对于那些不知道不可抗力是什么意思的人，它是指发生了一个超出生活之上的事件，是无法控制的，比如洪水之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Force majeure, force of nature, something unexpected, and they don't have to pay the money, and they don't send the $3 billion.
zh: 不可抗力，自然之力，某种意外，那他们就不必付钱，他们没有把那 30 亿美元打过来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I remember by this point I've taken so many hits.
zh: 我记得到这个时候我已经挨了太多打击。

speaker: Unknown
en: At this point, I'm already practiced.
zh: 到这个时候，我已经有经验了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I look up to the heavens and I say, thank you, God.
zh: 我抬头望向天空，我说，感谢上帝。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do we need to learn from this one?
zh: 这次我们要从中学到什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: This one I'm already ready to learn.
zh: 这一次我已经准备好去学了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the lesson there was apparently litigation is what we need to learn from this one.
zh: 而那个教训显然就是，诉讼是我们这次需要学的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we go into very complicated litigation.
zh: 于是我们进入了非常复杂的诉讼。

speaker: Unknown
en: When the litigation ends with a settlement of a billion and a half, so instead of the three billion, it ends up being half.
zh: 当诉讼以 15 亿美元的和解结束时——所以不是 30 亿，最后变成了一半。

speaker: Unknown
en: So everybody gets half, but it's done.
zh: 所以每个人都拿到一半，但事情了结了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We negotiate a certain negotiation and was going to take a certain time for the money to come in.
zh: 我们进行了一定的谈判，钱到账还需要一定的时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Rebecca was just about to give birth.
zh: 而 Rebecca 就快要生了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was four days before she was giving birth.
zh: 这是在她分娩前四天。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I walk in with my best friend, Andrew Finkelstein, who was there with me for this whole experience.
zh: 我和我最好的朋友 Andrew Finkelstein 一起走进去，他陪我经历了这整段经历。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we walk into, because this is Corona, so everything's on Zoom.
zh: 我们走进去，因为这是新冠时期，所以一切都在 Zoom 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: So Eric Seiler, the litigator, is in his house in New York.
zh: 所以诉讼律师 Eric Seiler 在他纽约的家里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're in the Hamptons.
zh: 我们在汉普顿。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're in Japan.
zh: 他们在日本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody's all over the place.
zh: 每个人都分散在各地。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we walk in to tell Rebecca the settlement that we agreed and we settled, but the money will come in two months and this will happen and that will happen.
zh: 我们走进去告诉 Rebecca 我们达成的和解，我们已经和解了，但钱会在两个月后到账，然后会发生这个、会发生那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she says, no.
zh: 她说，不行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're supposed, if we don't close the deal, Monday, we're going to court.
zh: 如果我们不在周一完成交易，我们就要上法庭。

speaker: Unknown
en: And court was not, A, not going to be great for anyone.
zh: 而上法庭，第一，对任何人来说都不会好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And B, it wasn't great for WeWork because if we weren't going to go to court, another investor was going to come.
zh: 第二，对 WeWork 也不好，因为如果我们不上法庭，另一个投资者会来。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're going to take the WeWork at least to the chance.
zh: 他们至少会把 WeWork 拿去赌一把。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: and she goes, no, we've already had, they were supposed to pay April 1st for 2020.
zh: 她说，不行，我们已经有过了，他们本应在 2020 年 4 月 1 日付款。

speaker: Unknown
en: They didn't pay.
zh: 他们没付。

speaker: Unknown
en: The 3 billion.
zh: 那 30 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: The 3 billion.
zh: 那 30 亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why are you now settling the 3 billion with another agreement to delay payment again?
zh: 为什么你们现在又要用另一个推迟付款的协议去和解那 30 亿？

speaker: Unknown
en: What if they don't pay?
zh: 如果他们又不付呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: And now you missed your court date.
zh: 而且这次你们错过了开庭日期。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either they pay and then they're settled.
zh: 要么他们付钱，然后事情就了结了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll all say thank you and everybody will walk away.
zh: 我们都会说声谢谢，然后每个人各走各路。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's not just paying to us.
zh: 而且不只是付给我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: That billion and a half is to all the employees and all the investors.
zh: 那十五亿是给所有员工和所有投资人的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's half a billion to us and a billion to everyone else.
zh: 五亿给我们，十亿给其他所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either, and I know for all of us listening, that these are outrageously large numbers.
zh: 不管怎样——我知道我们所有听节目的人都明白——这些都是大得离谱的数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: I completely acknowledge and understand.
zh: 我完全承认也完全理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either they pay or they don't.
zh: 要么他们付钱，要么不付。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I say to her, what do you want to do?
zh: 我对她说，你想怎么办？

speaker: Unknown
en: We agreed on it.
zh: 我们已经达成一致了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she goes, tell them you agreed on it, but your wife didn't.
zh: 她说，告诉他们你同意了，但你妻子没同意。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she goes, you didn't do the money aside that we talked.
zh: 她还说，你根本没按我们说好的那样把钱留出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: You signed the personal guarantee.
zh: 你签了个人担保。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not just your money.
zh: 这不只是你的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is our money.
zh: 这是我们两个人的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I don't accept the settlement.
zh: 我不接受这个和解。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go back and tell them that either they pay it.
zh: 回去告诉他们，要么他们付钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tomorrow's, this was like a Thursday, this was Wednesday.
zh: 那时候——这事大概是个周四——不对，是周三。 [[2356→]] 之前我们有一个 Schedule C 章节，定在周五早上八点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before, we had a Schedule C section, so Friday, 8 a.m.
zh: 以前,我们有一个 Schedule C 环节,所以是周五早上 8 点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either they pay it before Friday, 8 a.m., or we'll see everybody in court on Monday.
zh: 要么他们在周五早上八点之前付钱，要么我们周一法庭上见。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she said also tell them that any horrible thing that's ever been said about you has been on the press and public.
zh: 她还说，也告诉他们，任何关于你的可怕言论都已经在媒体和公开场合出现过了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all out there.
zh: 全都摆在那儿了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So...
zh: 所以……

speaker: Unknown
en: Eric Seiler calls me and he says, I tell, so actually Rebecca called him and he said, Adam, I have a question for you.
zh: Eric Seiler 打电话给我，他说——实际上，是 Rebecca 先打给了他——他说，Adam，我有个问题要问你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who do I work for?
zh: 我到底是为谁工作？

speaker: Unknown
en: You or Rebecca?
zh: 是你还是 Rebecca？

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, well, you work for me and I work for Rebecca.
zh: 我说，嗯，你为我工作，而我为 Rebecca 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you work for Rebecca because that's what I thought because she called me and told me I'm a lousy lawyer.
zh: 也就是说你是为 Rebecca 工作的——因为我也正这么想，因为她打电话给我，说我是个很糟糕的律师。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, you're not a lousy lawyer.
zh: 我说，你不是一个糟糕的律师。

speaker: Unknown
en: She just doesn't like our settlement.
zh: 她只是不喜欢我们的和解方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we did get to a resolution.
zh: 但我们确实达成了一个解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: I go, what do you think we should do?
zh: 我说，你觉得我们该怎么办？

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, you have no choice.
zh: 他说，你别无选择。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should tell them there's no deal.
zh: 你应该告诉他们，没有交易了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, what are they going to do?
zh: 我说，他们会怎么做？

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, they're going to explode.
zh: 他说，他们会炸掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, and then, I don't know.
zh: 他说，然后呢，我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: Either they'll meet you in court and this was a horrible decision or they'll break and send the money.
zh: 要么他们会在法庭上跟你较量，那样这就是个糟糕的决定；要么他们会妥协，把钱送过来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, what do you think is going to happen?
zh: 我说，你觉得会发生什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, I've never been in this position.
zh: 他说，我从没遇到过这种处境。

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, I don't know.
zh: 他说，我不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: Said, OK. Got on the phone.
zh: 我说，好。拿起了电话。

speaker: Unknown
en: We told them what we told them.
zh: 我们把该说的说了。

speaker: Unknown
en: They hung, they screamed, bah, bah, bah.
zh: 他们——他们大吼，吧啦吧啦。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to sue you for this and sue you for that.
zh: 我们要为这个告你、为那个告你。

speaker: Unknown
en: They hung up the Zoom.
zh: 他们挂断了 Zoom。

speaker: Unknown
en: I called Eric, what now?
zh: 我打电话给 Eric，现在怎么办？

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, now we wait.
zh: 他说，现在我们等。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two hours later, Marcelo calls.
zh: 两个小时后，Marcelo 打来电话。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Marcelo is not the person who made the original investment in me.
zh: 而 Marcelo 并不是当初投资我的那个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Marcelo Klor, at the time, he was a very big personality in SoftBank.
zh: Marcelo Klor，当时，他是 SoftBank 里非常有分量的人物。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today he has his own business.
zh: 今天他有了自己的生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every time that I've had an interaction with me, he's always kept his word and always did the right thing.
zh: 每次我和他打交道，他都言而有信，总是做正确的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even when I didn't agree with him, he told it to me straight.
zh: 即使我不赞同他，他也直话直说。

speaker: Unknown
en: I respect him a lot.
zh: 我非常尊重他。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Marcelo calls me.
zh: 然后 Marcelo 打电话给我。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's on the walker.
zh: 他拄着助行器。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like a tall guy.
zh: 他是个高个子。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's on this walker.
zh: 他拄着这个助行器。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, call Rebecca.
zh: 他说，打给 Rebecca。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, are you sure, Marcelo?
zh: 我说，你确定吗，Marcelo?

speaker: Unknown
en: She's like on the couch, call Rebecca.
zh: 她在沙发上呢，打给 Rebecca。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was like, okay.
zh: 我说，好吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I call Rebecca, she's coming in again, right before birth.
zh: 我打给 Rebecca，她又来了，就在生产前。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she's standing there next to me, and her sister goes, Rebecca, I wanted to tell you that you and Adam were ahead of your time.
zh: 她站在我旁边，她姐姐说，Rebecca，我想告诉你，你和 Adam 走在了时代前面。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's so correct.
zh: 他说得太对了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, the world is lonely.
zh: 他说，世界是孤独的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The world is disconnected.
zh: 世界是割裂的。

speaker: Unknown
en: People need we, people need to bring people together.
zh: 人们需要 we，人们需要把人聚集起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: People need community.
zh: 人们需要社区。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're 10 years ahead of your time.
zh: 你们领先了时代十年。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think we were 10 years.
zh: 我不觉得我们领先了十年。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think we were five years ahead of our time because the world's moving so fast.
zh: 我觉得我们领先了时代五年，因为世界变化太快了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because I just want to tell you, the money will be in the bank before you give birth.
zh: 因为我只是想告诉你，钱会在你生产之前到账。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sorry we had to go through all of this.
zh: 很抱歉我们不得不经历这一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is just business.
zh: 这只是生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nothing here was personal.
zh: 这里没有任何针对个人的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll take the keys.
zh: 我们会拿走钥匙。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hopefully we do well by the company, but we're good.
zh: 希望我们把公司经营好，但我们没问题了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Gets off the Zoom.
zh: 挂掉了 Zoom。

speaker: Unknown
en: I look at her.
zh: 我看着她。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say, now what?
zh: 我说，现在怎么办？

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, fine, sign the documents.
zh: 她说，行吧，签文件吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, but you said we can't do it if the money's not in.
zh: 我说，可你说过钱不到账就不能签。

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, no, no, we're all good now.
zh: 她说，不，不，现在都没问题了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We signed.
zh: 我们签了。

speaker: Unknown
en: At 4.30 a.m., the money hits the account.
zh: 凌晨四点半，钱到了账户。

speaker: Unknown
en: We all get on a Zoom.
zh: 我们都上了 Zoom。

speaker: Unknown
en: At 8 a.m., I'm in Mount Sinai Hospital, great hospital.
zh: 早上八点，我在 Mount Sinai 医院，一家很棒的医院。

speaker: Unknown
en: Rebecca is giving birth to Moses.
zh: Rebecca 正在生 Moses。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everybody took a deep breath.
zh: 所有人都松了一口气。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're here today.
zh: 然后我们今天走到了这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Adam, I have, I'm going to wrap up, but I have these five pieces of empty card.
zh: Adam，我，我快收尾了，但我有这五张空白卡片。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I wanted to give you the opportunity to write on it.
zh: 我想给你机会在上面写点什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you okay with writing or shall I write it for you?
zh: 你介意自己写吗，还是我替你写？

speaker: Unknown
en: You'll write for me.
zh: 你替我写。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can write for it.
zh: 我可以替你写。

speaker: Unknown
en: With my dyslexia.
zh: 我有阅读障碍。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just the five most important lessons that you have learned over since the beginning of WeWork.
zh: 就是从 WeWork 成立以来你学到的最重要的五个教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I guess from the beginning of your early years.
zh: 好吧，我想是从你早期那会儿开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: How about we just do the five lessons I feel we learned today by talking?
zh: 不如就通过聊天，来谈谈我觉得我们今天学到的五个教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sure.
zh: 好啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Lesson one.
zh: 第一个教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: Choose your life partner.
zh: 选择你的人生伴侣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: friends and business partners for the worst day in your life, not for the best.
zh: 朋友和生意伙伴，要为你人生中最糟糕的那一天来选，而不是为最好的那一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Great advice.
zh: 很好的建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: Listen to life is not about when we fall down.
zh: 记住，人生不在于我们何时跌倒。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's about how we get up.
zh: 而在于我们如何站起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Number two.
zh: 第二个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Choose the life partner that will make you the best version of yourself.
zh: 选择那个能让你成为最好的自己的人生伴侣。

speaker: Unknown
en: The one that you need, not the one that you think you want.
zh: 选择你需要的那个，而不是你以为自己想要的那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Control doesn't come from power.
zh: 掌控不是来自权力。

speaker: Unknown
en: It comes from influence.
zh: 它来自影响力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And influence needs to be errant every single day from the beginning.
zh: 而影响力需要从最开始就每天去努力赢得。(原文 errant 疑为 earned,照原稿处理)

speaker: Unknown
en: And last but not least, we all have a destiny and a journey.
zh: 最后但同样重要的是，我们每个人都有自己的命运和旅程。

speaker: Unknown
en: get to know yourself so you can start living yours.
zh: 去了解你自己，这样你才能开始活出属于你的人生。

speaker: Unknown
en: That one's for you.
zh: 那条是说给你听的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I thought so.
zh: 是，我也觉得是。

speaker: Unknown
en: Adam, thank you so much.
zh: Adam,非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: I couldn't be more excited by all the wonderful things you're doing at Flow at the moment.
zh: 我对你此刻在 Flow 做的所有这些了不起的事情感到无比兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: Got some wonderful photos here of like the team and I've looked into the business.
zh: 这里有一些团队和我的精彩照片，我也研究过这家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I also had your partner,
zh: 我还收到了你的合伙人，

speaker: Unknown
en: your partner, one of the greatest investors of all time.
zh: (同上)

speaker: Unknown
en: Ben Horowitz will write me this beautiful letter where he talks about the amazing journey he's had with you, why he backed you, and how amazingly collaborative you've been, what a sponge you are for learning, and how he strongly believes that you are now building a generational business that will change the world, and how proud he is to be associated with a man like you.
zh: Ben Horowitz 给我写的这封美丽的信，他在信中谈到他和你的精彩旅程、他为什么投你、你有多么乐于协作、你多么像一块学习的海绵，以及他多么坚信你正在打造一家将改变世界的世代级企业，还有他为自己能与像你这样的人产生关联而感到多么自豪。

speaker: Unknown
en: He tells us all,
zh: 他告诉我们所有人，

speaker: Unknown
en: Ben Horowitz.
zh: Ben Horowitz。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should never judge a founder by his worst moment.
zh: 我们永远不应该用创始人最糟糕的时刻来评判他。

speaker: Unknown
en: But with Adam, that was easy because his light shined and shines so brightly.
zh: 但对 Adam 来说，这很容易，因为他的光芒曾经闪耀、并且至今依然如此耀眼。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have over-delivered in every sense of the
zh: 你在方方面面都超额兑现了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you, Adam.
zh: 谢谢你，Adam。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's beautiful.
zh: 这太美好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want Steven to thank you.
zh: 我想让 Steven 谢谢你。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know we had a real discussion because I learned a few things for the first time.
zh: 我知道我们有过一场真正的讨论，因为我第一次学到了一些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you made me talk out loud about a few things that I've almost never had.
zh: 你让我大声说出了一些我几乎从未谈及的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I appreciate it.
zh: 我很感激。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm going to think about it and I'm going to learn from it.
zh: 我会去思考这些，并从中学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's your last word?
zh: 你的最后一句话是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there anything at all that you wanted to leave the audience with?
zh: 你有没有任何想留给观众的话？

speaker: Unknown
en: We all came to this planet with a purpose and a destiny.
zh: 我们每个人都带着一个使命和一种命运来到这个星球。

speaker: Unknown
en: We started this life as this perfect light.
zh: 我们以这道完美的光开启这一生。

speaker: Unknown
en: Noise came, challenges came, people came, ego came, everything came.
zh: 噪音来了，挑战来了，人们来了，自我来了，一切都来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is up to all of us to have the courage to look inside, see whatever are the things that are stopping us from really becoming the best version of myself, of ourselves.
zh: 我们所有人都要有勇气向内看，看清究竟是什么在阻止我们真正成为最好的自己、最好的我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Surround ourselves with the right people, with the right family, both real family, spiritual family, whatever you consider your best and closest.
zh: 让自己身边围绕着对的人、对的家人，无论是现实中的家人，还是心灵上的家人，无论你认为谁是你最亲近、最好的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And go and chase your dream, your journey, your truth.
zh: 然后去追逐你的梦想、你的旅程、你的真相。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I know as a fact that if you go through the process, if you remember that life is not about how we fall and how many people saw us fall, it's genuinely about how we get up.
zh: 而且我知道一个事实：如果你经历这个过程，如果你记住人生不在于我们如何跌倒、有多少人看到了我们跌倒，它真正在于的是我们如何站起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you have the courage to really be the full version of yourself, and you're truthful about not just your strength, but also the weaknesses, and if you remember that it truly is a journey, that when you get to that last few minutes of your life, you're going to look around,
zh: 如果你有勇气真正活出完整的自己，并且诚实地面对不仅你的优点，还有你的弱点，如果你记住这确实是一段旅程，那么当你走到生命的最后几分钟时，你会环顾四周，

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going to be surrounded by loved ones and by a lot, a lot of love that you've created and cultivated for your entire life.
zh: 你将会被所爱的人包围,被你一生所创造和培养的许许多多的爱包围。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that you're going to live this world and this planet much better than it was before you came.
zh: 而且你会让这个世界、这个星球,比你来到之前变得好得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wish you and all of us good luck at this journey of life.
zh: 我祝愿你,也祝愿我们所有人,在这场人生的旅途中好运。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amen.
zh: 阿门。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amen.
zh: 阿门。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're done.
zh: 我们结束了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
